title: Assistant Manager - HR
description:
**Job Title: Assistant Manager – HR**

**Location:**Thane, Wagle Estate

***Role Summary***

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and experienced **Assistant Manager – HR** to manage end\-to\-end payroll operations, statutory compliance, and HR administration while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and adherence to applicable labour laws. The role will be responsible for payroll processing, attendance management, statutory compliance, employee loan administration, HRMS management, full \& final settlements, and HR documentation to support smooth HR operations across the organization.

***Key Responsibilities***

**1\. Payroll Management**

* Manage end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing, ensuring timely and accurate salary disbursement.
* Validate payroll inputs including attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, bonuses, deductions, and reimbursements.
* Process annual increments, salary revisions, appraisal letters, and payroll\-related employee records.
* Prepare payroll reports and reconcile payroll data with the Finance team.

**2\. Attendance \& Leave Management**

* Monitor and validate employee attendance and leave records through the HRMS.
* Ensure accurate attendance data for payroll processing.
* Resolve attendance and leave discrepancies in coordination with department heads.

**3\. HRMS \& Payroll System Management**

* Administer and maintain the HRMS and payroll software, ensuring accurate employee master data.
* Upload and validate payroll inputs, attendance records, salary revisions, and statutory updates in the system.
* Coordinate with software vendors for issue resolution, system enhancements, and implementation of payroll\-related updates.
* Support HRMS automation initiatives and ensure data accuracy and system compliance.

**4\. Bonus, Gratuity \& Employee Benefits**

* Calculate and process statutory bonus and gratuity as per applicable laws.
* Maintain employee benefit records and ensure timely processing of eligible payments.
* Support administration of employee compensation and benefits.

**5\. Employee Loan Processing**

* Manage employee loan applications, approvals, documentation, and disbursement records as per company policy.
* Ensure accurate loan deductions through payroll and maintain loan repayment schedules.
* Prepare loan\-related reports and reconcile outstanding balances.

**6\. Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely compliance with PF, ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), Bonus, Gratuity, and other statutory requirements.
* Prepare and submit statutory returns within prescribed timelines.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, and documentation.
* Stay updated on changes in labour laws and ensure organizational compliance.

**7\. Labour Law \& Factory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Labour Laws, the Factory Act, and other employment regulations.
* Support internal and external statutory audits and labour inspections.
* Coordinate with government authorities and consultants on compliance matters as required.

**8\. Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)**

* Process Full \& Final Settlements for resigned and terminated employees.
* Ensure accurate settlement of salary, leave encashment, gratuity, bonus, recoveries, loan adjustments, and statutory payments.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, and departmental stakeholders for timely employee separation.

**9\. HR Documentation \& Operations**

* Prepare appointment letters, confirmation letters, appraisal letters, increment letters, transfer letters, and other employee correspondence.
* Maintain employee records and ensure complete HR documentation.
* Support onboarding, employee lifecycle management, and HR policy implementation.

**10\. Reporting \& Process Improvement**

* Generate payroll MIS, statutory reports, compliance dashboards, and management reports.
* Recommend improvements to payroll, HRMS, and compliance processes for greater efficiency and accuracy.
* Ensure confidentiality and integrity of employee payroll and personal data.

**Qualification \& Experience**

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* 6–10 years of experience in Payroll, HR Operations, and Statutory Compliance.
* Experience in a manufacturing environment will be preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS and payroll software.

**Key Competencies**

* End\-to\-End Payroll Management
* HRMS \& Payroll Software Administration
* Attendance \& Leave Management
* Employee Loan Processing
* PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, Bonus \& Gratuity Administration
* Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)
* Labour Laws \& Factory Act Compliance
* Payroll Reconciliation \& MIS Reporting
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Advanced MS Excel and HRMS proficiency
* Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and meet strict deadlines

Pay: ₹45,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

​Company Name: Boop Org Pvt Ltd

Location: Sector 90, Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Job Type: Full\-time

Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month

Open Positions: 1

​About Boop Org Pvt Ltd

​Boop Org Pvt Ltd is a growing organization based out of Sector 90, Noida. We are dedicated to building a productive, positive, and collaborative workplace environment. We are looking for a reliable and organized HR Executive to join our team, manage our day\-to\-day HR operations, and support our team’s growth.

​Job Summary

​We are seeking an HR Executive with 1 to 2 years of prior HR experience to oversee our core human resource operations. In this role, you will be responsible for candidate sourcing, end\-to\-end recruitment coordination, employee onboarding, attendance tracking, and maintaining accurate HR documentation.

​Note: This position requires prior experience in an HR or recruitment setting. Candidates with no prior experience will not be considered.

​Detailed Roles \& Responsibilities

​1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment

​Create, post, and manage job postings on job portals (Indeed, Naukri, LinkedIn, etc.).

​Screen incoming resumes, conduct initial telephone screenings to assess candidate suitability, and shortlist qualified candidates.

​Schedule, coordinate, and align interviews with relevant department managers and handle interview follow\-ups.

​Build and maintain a talent pipeline for recurring or future operational roles.

​2\. Onboarding \& Documentation

​Manage the complete onboarding experience for incoming staff, including document verification (ID, education, experience certificates).

​Issue offer letters, appointment letters, and non\-disclosure agreements (NDAs).

​Create and update digital and physical employee files to ensure compliance with company policies.

​Conduct orientation sessions to introduce new employees to company policies, culture, and workflow.

​3\. HR Operations, Attendance \& Leave Management

​Track daily employee attendance, shift timings, and leave requests on a daily basis.

​Maintain monthly attendance registers and coordinate with management/payroll for accurate salary calculations.

​Serve as the first point of contact for employees regarding company policies, leave balances, and general administrative queries.

​4\. Employee Engagement \& Office Culture

​Plan, organize, and execute team\-building activities, birthday celebrations, and workplace events to foster a positive environment.

​Assist in conducting exit interviews, processing resignations, and completing formal clearance procedures (F\&F).

​Candidate Requirements \& Qualifications

​Experience: Minimum 1 to 2 years of proven working experience as an HR Executive, HR Assistant, or Recruitment Coordinator. (Freshers need not apply).

​Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration (BBA/B.Com/BA), or a related field.

​Key Skills:

​Proficiency with MS Office (Excel, Word) or Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs).

​Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

​Hands\-on experience screening candidates and using recruitment platforms.

​Strong organizational skills and strict attention to operational detail.

​Professional demeanor with the ability to handle confidential employee information responsibly.

​Work Schedule \& Working Model

​2nd \& 4th Saturdays: Off / Holiday

title: Senior Manager – Transitions
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


You’ll be part of the Transition and Transformation organisation, reporting into the Transition and Transformation Head working in close collaboration and partnership with multiple stakeholders across the board to enable delivery of the Haleon strategic roadmap.
  

  

You’ll enjoy the challenge of a fast\-paced, problem\-solving environment that requires you to think and act quickly to address strategic and day\-to\-day business priorities.


You’ll be empowered and accountable to deliver transitions end \- end spanning multiple Haleon functions, business units globally.


**About the Role**

The Global Transition and Transformation function has oversight and end to end delivery accountability for a wide portfolio of transformation programs and projects spanning Operating Model, Process and Enterprise level transformation. Your role therefore is pivotal to front\-ending and delivering the Operating Model transformation road map for Haleon.


* **Transition Scoping and planning:**
	+ Facilitate discovery workshops and document transition scope. Plan follow\-ups where required.
	+ Facilitate planning workshops; develop and baseline the end\-end transition roadmap / plan.
* **Business Case:** Closely monitor spend; manage baseline changes through change control.
* **Governance:**
* Partner with the Global PMO to ensure toll gate criteria are well defined relative to the transition nature and tollgates are orchestrated in line with the transition plan. Prepare content for tollgates.
* Prepare status reports on overall transition health for report\-out at weekly governance. Leverage standard tooling and best practices as prescribed by the Global PMO for status updates.
* **Detailed Design / Solutioning, Knowledge Transfer (KT) planning:**
	+ Consolidate outcomes of the detailed design for report\-out.
	+ Facilitate Knowledge Transfer planning workshops covering all aspects of the processes to be transitioned with clear alignment on scope, trainers, timelines, and ways of working.
* **Recruitment, Onboarding, Knowledge Transfer (KT):**
	+ Participate in recruitment steer cos; ensure HR gets required support from business to hire at pace.
	+ Align with IT requirements and raise provisioning requests in line with onboarding timelines.
	+ Onboard new joiners and orient / deploy for KT in accordance with the KT plan.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Plan stakeholder connects at an agreed cadence to keep them informed of the transition progress. Maintain a stakeholder log evidencing stakeholder engagement (Actions from the meetings, follow up plans etc.)

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide strategic leadership for large, complex, multi\-country transitions and operating model transformations.
* Own transition portfolio prioritization and resource planning in alignment with enterprise strategy.
* Act as escalation point for risks, issues, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Mentor and develop Managers and Leads within the Transition \& Transformation team.
* Partner with senior business leaders to shape future transition opportunities and business cases.
* Drive standardization, best practices, and continuous improvement across transition methodology.

Experience (Senior Manager)


* 14\+ years of progressive experience in large\-scale transitions, transformations, or shared services environments.
* Demonstrated leadership of geographically distributed teams and senior executive stakeholders.
* Experience influencing strategy and decision\-making at Director / VP levels.

You will be supported by colleagues who live the culture of making Haleon a diverse and inclusive employer. We believe in agile working for all roles. If flexibility is important to you, our hybrid philosophy will certainly support you to stretch, learn and grow every day. This is your invitation to make everyday health more achievable, more inclusive and more sustainable.


**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* 14\+ years demonstrated experience of transitioning processes from local markets to Shared Services Captives, Outsourcing partners etc.
* Transition management experience across multiple functions (Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Tech etc.) in a Consumer goods company is a plus, but not mandatory
* Demonstrated proficiency in project, program, portfolio management processes and principles
* Demonstrated experience delivering projects through both Agile and waterfall approach is desirable.
* Demonstrated resilience in navigating through complex and ambiguous change.
* Excellent interpersonal (communication and presentation) and organizational skills
* Hands on experience on PM tools – Example MS Project, MS P4W, Jira, Confluence, Teams
* Certifications – PMP, Prince 2

This is a unique opportunity to influence change, interact with global stakeholders on projects and programs that drive a real impact to the Haleon businesses. Your ability to ‘make things happen’ coupled with a ‘positive can\-do attitude’ will set you up for success in this role.  



 **Job Posting End Date**

2026\-08\-15  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.  



**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.  



**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Senior Lead Compensation
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**Your Role**  

Kyndryl is looking to hire a strategic and dynamic Senior Lead Compensation to support our Asia Pacific markets and our data analytic needs. The Senior Lead will play a key role in supporting the evolution of our compensation programs to ensure we can attract, retain, and inspire top talent in the fast\-paced technology industry. This role will be hands\-on in implementing transformative compensation programs and designing efficient processes to support them. The role is split roughly evenly across two distinct areas: (1\) Compensation Analytics, dashboard, insights, and (2\) compensation partnering and advisory for our Asia Pacific markets, where strong stakeholder collaboration and client\-facing consulting skills are essential.
  

  

**What you will do**  

Key responsibilities include:


Role \& Responsibilities:


* Execute Employee compensation strategy based on global compensation and business strategy and facilitate the global compensation programs roll\-out at market/country level.
* Be a trusted partner and consult with HR Partners and senior business managers on pay decisions and related challenges and provide strategic and operational guidance and direction.
* Act as a strategic compensation partner to HR leaders and business executives across Asia Pacific, providing consultation on compensation decisions, workforce planning, talent attraction, retention, and pay governance.
* Serve as an advocate of the Total Rewards philosophy. Own local Compensation programs to align with the corporate and market/country strategy.
* Develop compensation analytics, models, dashboards, and insights related to pay competitiveness, pay equity, salary movements, hiring premiums, retention risks, and workforce trends to support business and compensation strategy
* Provide analytical insights to business and leadership related to compensation and assist them in decision making.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as HR Tech, CIO, Finance, Payroll, Legal, ER/LR,. to drive the execution efficiency and ensure seamless employee/manager experience.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve, digitize \& automate compensation processes. Ensure compliance of compensation policies with local regulatory requirements.
  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.  

  



**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of experience in HR preferably in Compensation with a thorough understanding of Employee Compensation.
* Proficiency in communicating complicated concepts to a broad audience. Familiar with Compensation Benchmarking Surveys and tools used. Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint
* Experience partnering with or advising stakeholders across Asia Pacific markets, with an understanding of regional pay practices and regulatory differences; strong consulting, influencing and cross\-cultural communication skills.
* Ability to maintain discretion with extremely confidential information. Ability to build trust\-based relationships HR Partners and management.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and written communication skills
* Ability to build a story with data to support business decisions and recommendations.
* Fluent (written and spoken) in English.

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Advanced analytical skills with expertise in Excel, compensation modelling, data visualization, and dashboard development; experience with Power BI or similar analytics tools preferred.

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:
Broomies Bakery is looking for a mature, highly organized, and responsible Senior Admin \& Operations Manager to oversee the day\-to\-day operations of our central production (Base Kitchen) and ensure seamless coordination with our four retail outlets across Faridabad.

The ideal candidate should have strong leadership skills, experience in food production or hospitality operations, and the ability to manage teams, vendors, inventory, dispatch, and administration efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Base Kitchen Operations

* Oversee complete daily operations of the central kitchen.
* Ensure timely production planning based on outlet requirements.
* Monitor productivity, hygiene, quality standards, and food safety.
* Coordinate with the Production Head to ensure smooth workflow.

2\. Dispatch \& Logistics

* Ensure accurate and timely dispatch of products to all four stores.
* Monitor dispatch schedules and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with drivers and dispatch staff for smooth daily operations.
* Resolve delivery\-related issues promptly.

3\. Team Management

* Supervise dispatch, store support, housekeeping, security, and administrative staff.
* Allocate duties and monitor staff performance.
* Maintain discipline and ensure adherence to company policies.
* Conduct daily operational meetings and provide guidance to team members.

4\. Purchase \& Vendor Management

* Handle procurement of raw materials, packaging, consumables, and operational supplies.
* Negotiate with suppliers for quality, pricing, and timely deliveries.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors.
* Track purchase orders and ensure cost control.

5\. Inventory \& Stock Control

* Monitor inventory levels of raw materials and packaging.
* Ensure accurate stock records and periodic stock audits.
* Minimize wastage and prevent stock shortages.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for inventory reconciliation.

6\. Store Coordination

* Maintain close coordination with all four Broomies outlets.
* Ensure outlets receive products on time and in the required quantities.
* Address operational issues reported by store managers.
* Ensure smooth communication between stores and the base kitchen.

7\. Administration

* Manage day\-to\-day administrative activities of the base kitchen.
* Oversee maintenance of equipment and facilities.
* Ensure statutory compliance, documentation, and record keeping.
* Coordinate with HR for attendance, staffing, and operational requirements.

8\. Reporting

* Prepare daily operational reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to production, dispatch, inventory, and purchases.
* Report operational challenges and recommend improvements to management.

Desired Candidate Profile

* Age: 38 years or above (preferred).
* Minimum 10 years of experience in administration and operations.
* Experience in bakery, food manufacturing, FMCG, hospitality, QSR, or central kitchen operations is highly preferred.
* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good knowledge of inventory management, procurement, dispatch, and administration.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Excel and ERP/POS systems.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple teams simultaneously.
* Honest, disciplined, proactive, and capable of making independent operational decisions.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹42,000\.00 per month

description:
**Job Summary**

The Production Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and controlling all production activities to ensure timely delivery, superior product quality, optimum productivity, and effective utilization of manpower and resources. The role focuses on achieving production targets, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring compliance with company policies and safety requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Production Planning \& Control**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production plans based on customer orders.
* Allocate work efficiently across departments and monitor production schedules.
* Ensure on\-time completion of orders as per committed delivery dates.
* Monitor production capacity and optimize resource utilization.

**2\. Production Operations**

* Supervise all manufacturing processes, including casting, die, CNC, filing, assembly, soldering, polishing and finishing.
* Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Resolve production issues promptly to avoid delays.

**3\. Quality Management**

* Ensure products meet internal quality standards and customer specifications.
* Monitor First Time Acceptance (FTA) and implement corrective actions to reduce rework.
* Coordinate with the Quality Control team for continuous quality improvement.

**5\. Delivery Management**

* Coordinate with Planning, Stores, and Dispatch to achieve customer delivery commitments.
* Monitor work\-in\-progress (WIP) and eliminate production bottlenecks.
* Ensure priority orders are completed on schedule.

**6\. Inventory \& Material Control**

* Monitor availability of raw materials, consumables, and production tools.
* Coordinate with Stores for timely material issuance.
* Control excess inventory and improve inventory turnover.

**7\. Team Management**

* Lead, motivate, and supervise production supervisors and operators.
* Conduct daily production review meetings.
* Identify training needs and support employee skill development.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, and productivity.
* Submitting various types of report from production department an timely submission to management and HR.

**8\. Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce cycle time, and minimize production costs.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Standardize production processes to improve efficiency.

**9\. Safety \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies.
* Ensure statutory and internal compliance requirements are followed.

**10\. Reporting**

* Prepare daily production reports and management dashboards.
* Analyze production efficiency, rejection, rework, delivery performance, and productivity.
* Present improvement plans to management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Production Management, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 8–15 years of experience in manufacturing company.
* Minimum 3–5 years in a Production Manager or similar leadership role.

description:

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### **Job Purpose**


Lead the Performance Management system, Compensation benchmarking, Job Evaluation \& Analysis and the design and roll\-out of Sales compensation interventions to support the business goals for all business units viz ABML \& ABARC. Adhere to statutory compliance and ensure that the C\&B initiatives implemented are aligned to the Group policies. Drive continuous improvement to enhance and improve effectiveness in the compensation and benefits function within the organization.  

Also responsible for HR Operations, Compliance \& Payroll for all business units viz ABML \& ABARC thus driving the entire employee life cycle.

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Job ContextLead the Performance Management system, Compensation benchmarking, Job Evaluation \& Analysis and the design and roll\-out of Sales compensation interventions to support the business goals for all business units viz ABML, ABIF, ABARC. Adhere to statutory compliance and ensure that the C\&B initiatives implemented are aligned to the Group policies. Drive continuous improvement to enhance and improve effectiveness in the compensation and benefits function within the organization.  

Also responsible for HR Operations, Compliance \& Payroll for all business units viz ABML, ABIF, ABARC thus driving the entire employee life cycle.  

  

Job Challenges: •Managing the pace of HR processes such as payroll, compensation, HRIS and operations with the growth of the business  

* Defining \& Managing (for all 3 entities) Compensation \& benefits programs in alignment with the ABCap Compensation architecture.
* Define process for performance evaluation criteria and measurement across levels and completion of performance calendar
* Drive pay to performance compensation philosophy by defining level based compensation banding \& structure.
* Enhance market intelligence on Compensation through benchmarking by participation in Compensation Surveys and internal database of new employees.
* Managing wage costs in a high growth industry to ensure compensation to OPEX ratio as per budgets.
* Responsible for HR process and payroll audit \& compliance.
* Ensuring effective management of multiple vendors.
* Drive Performance Management System completion across the organisation.
* Facilitating and creating HR structures and systems to build synergy across businesses and functions is challenging as all business operate under different regulator guidelines and processes.

  

* Volatile, competitive and disruptive environment requiring nimble planning and constant touch with internal as well as outside world. Ensuring seamless and uniform implementation of HR strategies in widely distributed offices and employees across the geography is challenging.

  

* All 3 business units – ABML, ABIF \& ABARC have different process and policies wrt various human resource functional aspects. It’s imperative to ensure the right yard stick is used to manage each policy. This needs to be micromanaged at each stages of process execution and is a big challenge.
#### **Key Result Areas**

  

**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**  


KRA1 Plan, initiate, and monitor the salary \& benefits budgeting process 1\.Conduct market benchmark surveys on compensation \& Benefits.  

2\.Perform budgeting analysis to determine salary increases and costs impacts on payroll.  

3\.Create robust compensation structures aligned to prevalent Tax norms  

4\.Creation of an effective compensation strategy to ring fence key talents for the organization (LTIP/Deferred Compensation/ESOPS)  

5\.Carry out the increment process in line with the guidelines keeping in mind market benchmarks  

6\.Manage salary budgets and roll\-out the increment exercise  

7\.Create an effective resolution framework/matrix \& ensure timely resolution for all employee queries related to compensation  

8\.Articulate, define and adequately document HR policies and guidelines for smooth functioning of relevant HR processes.  


KRA2 Initiate and drive the performance management cycle (Mid\-Year \& Annual) 1\.Facilitate business/ managers to define performance evaluation criteria  

2\.Collaborate for performance ratings analysis and ensure distribution curve.  

3\.Ensure the launch and completion of the performance management plan in a timely manner.  


KRA3 Drive the job evaluation exercise as per prevalent structures and roles 1\.Ensure organization structures are updated to reflect current realities  

2\.Drive and facilitate effective job description documentation exercise across Functions  

3\.Basis an in\-depth understanding of the job evaluation framework, ensure that the flow of roles, responsibilities and accountabilities is accurately captured in the Job Description documents  

4\.Ensure timely submission of complete documentation and data points for the various Job Evaluation Committees (BJEC, CJEC and APEX) where applicable  

5\.Ensure inputs from JE exercise are effectively used during annual and mid\-year appraisals and promotion / up\-gradation activities.  

6\.Ensure maintenance of accurate records in relation to the JE exercise  


KRA4 Design and Optimization of Compensation \& Target Setting  

* Develop an in\-depth understanding and benchmarking of compensation structures for various sales channels within the organization and across the industry.
* Continually assess the effectiveness of existing compensation structures to evaluate alignment with current and future organizational needs.
* Ensure compensation structure is designed across the sales hierarchy in a manner that supports the achievement of business objectives.
* Ensure appropriate KPI and Target Setting for the entire Sales \& Non\-Sales Hierachy
  


KRA5 Ensure smooth management of Poornata System for the organisation to ensure that employee records are maintained and updated in a timely manner 1\.Ensure adequate documentation and updation of JDs/KPI/KRA for all the roles in the organization and their validity against goal settings of the respective incumbents.  

2\.Conduct and collaborate on periodic information audits  

3\.Ensure efficient data management on Poornata System pertaining to employee records  

4\.Be part of the new systems development team and provide inputs to ensure that data is migrated accurately from legacy to new systems, conduct test scenarios with vendors  


KRA6 Plan, initiate and drive the benefits programs for the organisation 1\.Manage and implement employee benefit programs like insurance \& health schemes, make necessary recommendations \& improvements  

2\.Perform need gap analysis and initiate new benefit plans as well as ensure smoother operations of current schemes.  

3\.Communicate new initiatives to the organisation and employees and address queries, clarifications as well as grievances  


KRA7 Manage the development and implementation of all aspects of HR Operations\- Drive HR operations and enhance service delivery to all employees as per defined SLA’s \& TAT’s 1\.Define SOP's for all HR operations processes.  

2\.Manage life cycle of employee on HR administration aspects as per defined TAT’s  

3\.Initiate process and work flow improvements  

4\.Ensure the entire HR operational activities are executed smoothly and the HR processes are reviewed and updated in line with the ABC/ABG/Industry norms  

5\.Evaluate the existing processes for scope of improvements in building process efficiencies, reducing TATs, improving accuracy and opportunities to save costs  


KRA8 Manage Statutory compliance including the payroll function and the shared service support for the organization 1\.Ensure that the payroll processing is done smoothly and timely on a routine basis for all 3 Business Units  

2\.Ensure all statutory compliance are 100% adhered without any deviations.  

3\.Manage and align the HR Ops and Payroll Vendors and Business Partners in line with the HR agenda.  

4\.Ensure Process Governance, Audit Compliance \& Controls in all HR Operations and Payroll activities  


KRA9 Team Management 1\.Optimize employee talent and expertise.  

2\.Ensure adequate training, development opportunities and career planning is established for the team  

3\.Motivate the team and maintain employee satisfaction of team at optimal levels

**HR Talent Acquisition Intern**
================================

**The Basics**
--------------

**Team:** Human Resources  

**Experience:** Freshers / 1–2 HR internships  

**Location:** Mumbai – Andheri East

**Introduction**
================


$11 trillion of money flows every year between companies in India. It typically takes an average of 70 days for a business to get paid, and it's increasing by 5% every year. Formal funding options are limited and cover less than 5% of the addressable market.


We are building India's largest B2B Payments Platform that transforms how businesses pay and get paid. The platform already processes INR 20,000\+ Crores of invoices every month across 300,000 MSMEs and 1200\+ corporates, with 30\+ lenders plugged in for credit. Globally, companies in this space like Coupa, Bill.com, Melio, C2FO, and Tipalti have witnessed tremendous success over the past decade, doing $ Billion\+ disbursements weekly and cumulatively valued at over $50 Billion.


You will join our core team that currently consists of ex\-BCG and ISB/IIM alumni, with a team of industry veterans serving on the advisory board. We are backed by Elevation Capital (one of the most successful VCs in India) and General Catalyst ($15 Billion\+ global fund and early investors in Stripe, Airbnb, etc.). We share our lineage with HCS, a 25\-year\-old investment bank and registered NBFC.


We are a team of passionate problem solvers building a technology company with a strong product innovation mindset.


We are looking for someone who is ambitious, curious, highly organized, and eager to build a career in Human Resources. If you're someone who enjoys interacting with people, thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, and wants hands\-on exposure to Talent Acquisition and HR Operations, we'd love to hear from you.

====================================

* Screen resumes and identify suitable candidates based on role requirements.

* Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process to ensure a great candidate experience.
* Coordinate with hiring managers for interview feedback and interview logistics.
* Maintain and update candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Assist in preparing offer letters and supporting the offer rollout process.
* Track hiring metrics and maintain recruitment reports.

**2\. HR Operations**
---------------------

* Support employee onboarding by coordinating documentation and pre\-joining formalities.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Assist in background verification and document collection.
* Help coordinate employee engagement activities and HR initiatives.
* Support HR policy communication and other administrative HR tasks.
* Coordinate with internal teams for smooth onboarding and employee lifecycle activities.

**Our Ideal Candidate Will Have**
=================================

* Bachelor's degree (or currently pursuing the final year) in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent organizational and coordination abilities.
* A genuine interest in Talent Acquisition and Human Resources.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
* Good proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Naukri, or other job portals is a plus.
* High attention to detail and willingness to learn in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**What You'll Learn**
=====================

* End\-to\-end recruitment in a high\-growth startup.
* Candidate sourcing and employer branding.
* Interview coordination and stakeholder management.
* HR Operations and employee lifecycle processes.
* Working with HR tools, ATS platforms, and recruitment analytics.
* Exposure to startup hiring across multiple business functions.

**Joining CashFlo – Why It's a Great Choice**
=============================================

* **Uniquely Positioned for Success:** CashFlo sits at the unique intersection of Payments, Lending, and SaaS \- three of the fastest\-growing and most lucrative spaces globally and in India. As a part of our team, you will be a key player in an industry\-defining company.
* **An Opportunity to Create Wealth:** At CashFlo, we understand that our success is deeply linked with the success of our employees. That's why we offer the potential to create exponential wealth through equity in our rapidly growing early\-stage company. You will not only contribute to our growth story, but also share in the rewards.
* **A Collaborative and Driven Team:** We pride ourselves on fostering a culture that encourages kindness, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality. Our team members are always there to help each other, and we believe in lifting each other up. Your growth is our growth, and we succeed as a team.
* **Direct Impact on Company Success:** At CashFlo, every role is crucial. Your work will have a real, tangible impact on our success. You'll see the results of your hard work in real\-time.
* **Fast\-Track Your Career:** We invest in our employees' professional growth through comprehensive training programs, mentoring opportunities, and clear growth paths. Whether you aspire to grow as an individual contributor or on a management track, we provide the resources and support you need to accelerate your career.
* **Best\-in\-class Compensation and Benefits:** We offer competitive compensation, with best\-in\-class incentive structures. We value the work you do, and our compensation package reflects our commitment to attracting and retaining the best talent.
* **Unwavering Commitment to Excellence:** We are seeking individuals ready to dive into challenging work, individuals who are excited about going above and beyond to drive their own growth and the company's. If you are motivated by ambitious goals and are ready to make a significant impact, CashFlo is the place for you.

title: Senior Recruitment Ops Specialist
description:
Role Description:
**Company Introduction :**
Booking Holdings is the world’s leading provider of online travel and related services, serving consumers and local partners in over 220 countries and territories. We deliver our services through six primary brands: Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda, and OpenTable. Our mission is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

  

The Center of Excellence, based in Bangalore, India, is a legal entity of Booking Holdings Inc. It was established to support the growing business needs of the Booking Holdings brands. The Center provides access to specialized, highly skilled talent, promotes industry best practices, and fosters collaboration across all Booking Holdings brands and business units.

 **Job Overview :**
The Senior Recruiting Ops Specialist serves as a strategic partner to the Talent community, driving scalability and operational excellence by simplifying hiring processes and optimizing recruitment systems. By designing compliant practices, managing complex cross\-functional projects, and fostering innovation, this role ensures a seamless candidate experience while maintaining high standards of data integrity and governance, ultimately serving as an essential engine for the Talent team's success

 **Key Responsibilities**

* + Manage end\-to\-end Offer Management and Pre\-Onboarding activities, including offer creation, approvals, pre\-employment screening (PES), onboarding readiness, and ensuring a seamless candidate experience.
	+ Partner closely with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners, HR Operations, candidates, external vendors, and global teams to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant hiring processes.
	+ Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for TA systems and processes, ensuring the smooth day\-to\-day operation of recruitment systems, providing system support, resolving system issues, maintaining data quality, and supporting users with system\-related queries.
	+ Lead and support recruitment systems and process improvements, including change requests, system enhancements, automation initiatives, testing, and transformation projects in collaboration with global teams.
	+ Own vendor relationships and service delivery, ensuring effective partnership management, SLA adherence, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
	+ Support executive and complex hiring activities, including coordination for Executive hiring and other business\-critical recruitment processes.
	+ Develop, maintain, and communicate recruitment processes, policies, playbooks, and system updates, while driving standardization through training, knowledge sharing, and best practices across the TA community.
* **Own operational reporting and dashboarding, delivering accurate recruitment metrics, insights, and data analytics to support business decisions, operational reviews, and leadership reporting.**
* **Drive audits, compliance, and governance activities by performing regular quality checks, ensuring adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, data integrity standards, and recruitment controls, while identifying and mitigating operational risks.**
* Drive operational excellence by identifying opportunities for process optimization, innovation, automation, and improved stakeholder and candidate experience.
* Provide regular operational updates and stakeholder communications, ensuring hiring teams, HR Ops, and other business partners are informed of key activities such as onboarding readiness, system updates, and process changes.

 **Requirements*** + Bachelor's degree with 5\+ years of experience in Recruitment Operations
	+ Strong knowledge of recruitment processes, policies, guidelines and regulations, with hands\-on experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Workday, iCIMS, or similar platforms.
	+ Demonstrated expertise in Recruitment Systems and Talent Operations, with the ability to manage system enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and understand the impact of changes across end\-to\-end recruitment processes.
	+ Strong project management and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities, lead projects, and deliver results within defined timelines.
	+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams, draft communications, deliver training, and effectively collaborate with business leaders, technical teams, and external vendors.
	+ Ability to simplify complex technical concepts, translating business requirements into system solutions and technical information into user\-friendly guidance.
	+ Experience driving process improvements, automation, and operational excellence, with agility, and continuous improvement methodologies.
	+ Ability to coach and mentor team members, sharing knowledge and promoting best practices across the TA function.
* **Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides), with strong reporting, dashboarding, data analytics, and presentation skills.**
* **Experience with reporting and visualization tools e.g Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio is an advantage**

title: Workplace Service Delivery Assoc Manager
description:
**Job Description – Workplace Facility Management Associate Manager (CL\-8\)**

 **Job Requisition ID**:

**Job Title**: Workplace Facility Management Associate Manager

**Management Level**: CL – 8 (Associate Manager)

**Work Location**: Pune

**Must have Skills**: Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration

**Good to have Skills**: Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PMP Certification

**Experience**: Minimum 10 years of military experience with at least 2 \- 5 years of corporate IFM experience for Veterans/ Min 12 \- 15 years of experience in Facility management and administration for others.

**Educational Qualification**: Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full time MBA or both would be an added advantage.

**Department**:Corporate Function

**Job Summary**


Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**Integrated Facility management**

* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly /quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.

**Engineering and Technical Services**

* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

**Statutory Compliance and Risks**

* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.

**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**

* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads , CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.

**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**

* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.

**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**

* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.

**Cafeteria Management**

* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor .
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.

**Team Management**

* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**

* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.

**Projects and Transitions**

* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.

**Professional \& Technical Skills:**

* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word, working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.

**Additional Information:**

* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of Pune offices.

description:
Overview:

The Payroll Asst Analyst is responsible for supporting end\-to\-end payroll operations, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing, statutory compliance, reconciliations, reporting, and employee support. The role works closely with HR, Finance, external payroll vendors, and business stakeholders to maintain payroll accuracy and compliance.


Responsibilities:  

Payroll Processing

* Coordinate end\-to\-end payroll activities for assigned populations.
* Validate monthly payroll inputs including new hires, exits, transfers, promotions, salary changes, allowances, deductions, overtime, and leave adjustments.
* Review payroll outputs and identify discrepancies before final processing.
* Support payroll calendar execution and ensure all deadlines are met.


Payroll Validation \& Reconciliation

* Perform payroll audits and variance analysis.
* Prepare headcount and payroll value reconciliations month\-over\-month.
* Validate payroll reports, earning and deduction balances, and statutory outputs.
* Investigate payroll discrepancies and drive resolution with relevant stakeholders.


Finance \& Accounting Support

* Prepare and validate payroll journals and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with Finance and Treasury teams for salary payments.
* Support payroll accruals and month\-end activities.
* Ensure payroll accounting records are accurate and complete.


Compliance \& Statutory Activities

* Ensure compliance with labor laws, tax regulations, social security, PF, ESI, and other statutory requirements.
* Support statutory filings, audits, and documentation requests.
* Maintain payroll records in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.


Employee Support

* Respond to employee queries related to salary, tax, leave impact, shift allowance, reimbursements, and deductions.
* Provide payroll guidance to employees, managers, and HR partners.
* Ensure timely and accurate resolution of payroll tickets and escalations.


Vendor \& Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate with external payroll vendors for payroll processing and issue resolution.
* Partner with HR Operations, Benefits, Workforce Administration, Finance, and Treasury teams.
* Participate in payroll transitions, process standardization, and automation initiatives.


Continuous Improvement

* Identify process gaps and recommend automation opportunities.
* Support payroll transformation projects and process improvement initiatives.
* Maintain standard operating procedures and process documentation.

  


Qualifications:  

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, or related field.
* 5\-6 years of payroll operations experience.
* Experience with SAP, Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle, or other payroll systems preferred.
* Strong knowledge of payroll legislation and statutory compliance.
* Advanced Excel skills.

description:
**Company Description**  

NIQ’s Global Talent \& Development team enables people, managers, and leaders to build the capabilities that drive business performance. We deliver scalable, consistent, and high\-quality global learning experiences that support strategic priorities, strengthen organisational capability, and create a better learner experience across the enterprise.


The Global Learning Operations Administrator is a critical enabler of that experience. This role coordinates global learning delivery, administers Workday Learning, maintains accurate learning data and records, and ensures the operational foundations are in place for effective programme execution.


Sitting at the intersection of learning operations, systems administration, learner experience, and content enablement, this role helps NIQ deliver learning programmes efficiently, consistently, and at scale while continuously improving the tools, processes, and support that serve employees, managers, facilitators, and stakeholders.

 **Job Description** **Role Purpose**


The Global LMS Learning Administrator provides high\-quality operational, administrative, and systems support to the Global Talent \& Development team, with primary responsibility for Workday Learning administration and the consistent delivery of learner experiences across regions and time zones.


This role owns the day\-to\-day coordination of learning activities, including programme logistics, learner assignments, completion tracking, reporting, stakeholder queries, and training records, ensuring learning programmes are delivered accurately, efficiently, and with a strong service mindset.


Working closely with global stakeholders, facilitators, vendors, HRIS, and Learning Operations partners, the administrator supports end\-to\-end programme delivery while identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, strengthen reporting, and enhance the learner experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Learning Administration \& Delivery Support**

* Coordinate end\-to\-end global learning logistics, including programme scheduling, learner registration, facilitator support, participant communications, attendance tracking, and post\-session follow\-up.
* Support learning delivery across multiple regions and time zones, ensuring sessions are well organised, accessible, inclusive, and clearly communicated.
* Maintain global learning calendars, operational trackers, programme documentation, templates, and delivery records to ensure accuracy, consistency, and visibility.
* Partner effectively with internal stakeholders, facilitators, vendors, and external providers to ensure programmes are delivered on time, to standard, and with a high\-quality learner experience.
* Anticipate delivery risks, resolve operational issues quickly, and escalate where needed to keep global programmes on track.

**Workday Learning Administration for Global Training Delivery**

* Act as a primary administrator for Workday Learning, enabling reliable global learning operations and a seamless learner experience.
* Create, configure, and maintain courses, curricula, learning paths, campaigns, offerings, sessions, notifications, and learning assignments within Workday Learning.
* Manage learner enrolments, cancellations, waitlists, attendance, completions, certifications, status updates, and exception handling with accuracy and timeliness.

**Reporting, Stakeholder Support \& Continuous Improvement**

* Produce timely learning reports and dashboards to track attendance, completions, learner engagement, compliance requirements, operational performance, and programme effectiveness.
* Translate learning data into clear operational insights that help stakeholders understand progress, risks, gaps, and required actions.
* Support HR, Learning \& Development, HRIS, Compliance, and business stakeholders with reporting, communications, process guidance, and learner support.
* Identify and implement process improvement opportunities that enhance learner experience, increase efficiency, improve data quality, and reduce manual administration.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across learning operations, Workday learning, knowledge documentation, and support processes.

 **Qualifications**  

We are looking for someone who brings strong learning operations capability, excellent attention to detail, and the confidence to support global stakeholders in a fast\-moving environment. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in:

* Advanced administration of Workday Learning within a global or complex organisational environment.
* Configuring and maintaining Workday Learning courses, curricula, learning paths, sessions, offerings, campaigns, assignments, notifications, and reporting.
* Managing learner enrolments, attendance, completions, certifications, cancellations, waitlists, exception handling, and training records.
* Supporting compliance training, global programmes, large\-scale learning initiatives, or recurring enterprise learning cycles.
* Partnering with HRIS, Learning Operations, Shared Services, People Technology, Compliance, and business stakeholders.
* Producing learning reports, dashboards, and operational insights that support decision\-making and programme delivery.
* Supporting Workday Learning testing, validation, release activities, user acceptance testing, and system enhancements.

We are hiring a warm, self\-driven Admission Counsellor to own the parent\-facing side of our admissions function at a premium international school in Greater Noida.

This is a high\-ownership role for someone who genuinely enjoys sitting across from a family, understanding what they want for their child, and guiding them to a decision. The right candidate combines disciplined lead management with real counselling ability, an instinct for local outreach, and the confidence to represent an international school brand to a discerning Delhi NCR parent.

We are looking to close this role quickly. Candidates who can join immediately or within 15 days will be prioritised.

* Conduct campus tours, parent counselling sessions and follow\-up meetings with prospective families

Lead Management \& Enquiry Conversion

* Share weekly and monthly dashboards with school leadership

Branding, Marketing \& Outreach

* Coordinate content, collateral and parent testimonials for admissions marketing
* Identify and execute local brand\-building opportunities across Greater Noida, Greater Noida West, Noida and the Yamuna Expressway corridor

Institutional Tie\-ups \& Partnerships

* Build and maintain relationships with feeder preschools, high\-rise residential societies, corporate HR teams and relocation partners
* Develop referral networks with paediatricians, activity centres, tutoring centres and community influencers
* Work the corporate and industrial belt across Noida, Greater Noida and the Jewar airport corridor for transferee and relocating families
* Structure and manage MoUs with partner institutions

Parent Experience

* Ensure every parent interaction reflects the premium, international positioning of the school
* Handle parent queries, concerns and escalations with empathy and professionalism
* Support foreign\-national and NRI families through documentation, transfer certificates and onboarding
* Coordinate onboarding and the first\-day experience for every new admission

* Minimum 3 years of admissions experience at a reputed International, IB, Cambridge, CBSE or ICSE school
* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding enrolment targets in a K\-12 setting
* Strong understanding of the Delhi NCR K\-12 market and parent psychology in the premium school segment
* Excellent spoken and written English; fluent Hindi
* Confident presentation skills and genuine warmth in one\-on\-one parent counselling
* Proficient with CRM tools, MS Office and admissions dashboards
* Available to join immediately or within 15 days

* Existing relationships with feeder preschools, corporate HR teams and expat or relocation networks
* Experience handling foreign\-national or NRI admissions
* Exposure to digital admissions marketing and lead\-nurture automation

Other Requirements

* Willingness to travel across Delhi NCR regularly, and occasionally outside for admission fairs and outreach
* Graduate or Postgraduate in any discipline; specialisation in Education, Marketing, Psychology or Communications is a plus
* Own conveyance preferred, given the campus location
* Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply

What We Offer

* Fixed salary of ₹4\.2–5\.4 LPA with performance\-linked incentives on enrolments
* The opportunity to own admissions at a growing international school in one of NCR's fastest\-developing corridors
* Structured career growth into Senior Counsellor and Head of Admissions roles
* A collaborative environment with direct exposure to school leadership
* Travel allowance and ownership of local marketing activity

**Job Description Summary**
---------------------------


Lead Specialist independently resolves complex payroll exceptions, provides day\-to\-day guidance to Specialists, and supports cross\-coverage across payroll processes. The role drives issue resolution through advanced troubleshooting and contributes to documentation and process improvements.

**Primary Function**
--------------------


Responsible for executing and coordinating assigned payroll activities with 100% accuracy and timeliness. Acts as the first\-level escalation point, coaches L2 Specialists, and partners with SMEs/onshore teams to resolve issues and maintain documentation.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Process payroll and/or final pay checks accurately and ensure pay is delivered on time, following documented procedures and checklists.
* Work pay run audit reports; research and resolve errors/issues before checks are printed or files are transmitted; escalate exceptions as required.
* Monitor payroll mailboxes and ticket queues; respond to requests/forms within the 24\-hour SLA; document actions clearly and professionally.
* Apply US payroll policies, internal controls, and compliance requirements (confidentiality, approvals, audit trail) during daily execution.
* Support ad\-hoc activities and year\-end deliverables as assigned; adapt to peak volumes and critical timelines.
* Maintain current understanding of payroll calendar updates and process changes; complete required trainings on time.

**Additional responsibilities for this level:**

* Serve as first\-level escalation point for complex cases and aging tickets; coordinate resolution with partner teams as needed.
* Coach and mentor L2 Specialists on process execution, quality, and communication; provide onboarding and training support.
* Contribute to SOPs, checklists, and templates with version control; communicate changes to the team.
* Identify trends from audits and case data; recommend corrective actions and participate in small improvement initiatives.
* Support coverage planning within the sub\-team during peaks, downtime, and year\-end timelines.

### **Tax**

* Support employee tax setup changes and validations per workflow; ensure changes align to source documentation.
* Assist with tax\-related inquiries and ticket triage; resolve routine items and route complex items to SMEs/partners.
* Support year\-end activities such as W\-2 validations, corrections workflows, and reprint requests per process.

### **Banking**

* Support direct deposit maintenance and reject/return handling per workflow; ensure corrections are completed within required timelines.
* Assist with payroll funding/file checks and basic reconciliations per checklist; escalate discrepancies promptly.
* Log and track ACH rejects, reversals, and high\-risk exceptions to closure.

### **Garnishment**

* Set up and maintain garnishment/levy deductions based on received orders and established decision trees.
* Process routine agency communications and documentation within SLA; maintain required records.
* Support remittance processing and exception handling per controls; escalate complex scenarios.

### **Processing**

* Execute standard payroll processing steps (data entry, validations, adjustments) according to the payroll calendar.
* Run and review assigned audits; correct basic errors and coordinate dependencies with upstream partners.
* Support off\-cycle processing requests as directed; ensure documentation and approvals are complete.

### **Final Pay**

* Process final pay checks including PTO/other payouts per state requirements and documented guidance; escalate exceptions promptly.
* Support manual check requests, reissues, and reversals; ensure approvals and audit trail are complete.
* Respond to final pay inquiries from HR/field teams using templates and policy references.

**Reporting**
-------------


Reports to: Manager, Payroll Operations.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------


Minimum / Desired Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting/Business/Human Resources (or equivalent experience).
* 2\+ years of payroll operations experience with strong understanding of federal and state payroll requirements.
* Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; able to analyze reports and identify trends.
* Strong attention to detail; professional communicator able to handle escalations and stakeholder interactions.
* Demonstrated integrity and confidentiality; commitment to coaching and knowledge sharing.
* Flexibility to work extended hours during critical business timelines.
* FPC/CPP is an advantage; Workday/MyTime knowledge is preferred.

If you want to grow and develop as a part of a team that is shaping an industry, then we’re looking for the best to join us.  

Working at Dentsply Sirona you are able to:  

**Develop faster** \- with our commitment to the best professional development.  

**Perform better** \- as part of a high\-performance, empowering culture.  

**Shape an industry** \- with a market leader that continues to drive innovation.  

**Make a difference** \-by helping improve oral health worldwide.  

  

**Role Summary**Own and deliver the end\-to\-end planning and execution of clinical education programs, customer events, and internal meetings across the region. Act as a project manager and operational partner to Marketing, Sales, and Clinical Education teams to ensure high\-quality, compliant, and cost\-effective delivery.  


**Key Responsibilities***Event Planning \& Execution** Build and manage a rolling 18\-month event calendar (trade shows, dental exhibitions, PEERS, training programs, KOL engagements, internal meetings).
* Lead end\-to\-end event delivery—planning, logistics, registrations, travel, on\-site execution, and post\-event closure.
* Manage training materials, kits, and equipment logistics.

  


*Stakeholder \& Vendor Management** Partner with Clinical Education, KOLs, Sales, and Marketing to define and deliver event requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for participants and internal teams.
* Identify, negotiate, and manage vendors, hotels, and contracts.

  


*Budget, Compliance \& Governance** Plan and track event budgets, ensuring cost efficiency and accountability.
* Ensure adherence to compliance, legal, and corporate meeting policies.
* Support development of best practices and standardized processes.

  


*Clinical Education Operations** Coordinate CE programs including data management, invoice approvals, OPL payments, and PPSA tracking.
* Maintain OPL databases and manage clinical content (case reports, images, videos).
* Generate monthly reports and insights by product and region.

  


*Digital \& Content Management** Manage learning platforms (Academy) and coordinate with vendors for content updates.
* Maintain SharePoint and marketing collateral repositories for easy access and accuracy.

  


*Program Support \& Continuous Improvement** Support Train\-the\-Trainer initiatives, dentist training programs, and university collaborations.
* Track event performance and bring insights and improvements based on data and industry trends.

  


**Typical Background*** 3\+ years in event management / meeting planning / clinical education coordination
* Strong project management \& multitasking ability
* Proven vendor negotiation \& contract management experience
* Excellent stakeholder management \& communication skills
* High attention to detail with strong operational discipline
* Proficiency in MS Office \& collaboration tools (e.g., SharePoint)
* Ability to handle confidential information with integrity

  


**Success Looks Like*** Seamless, high\-quality event execution
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction
* Effective budget control \& compliance adherence
* Accurate data, reporting, and operational efficiency
