description:
Mechanical Engineering Freshers – Design / Production / Quality

**AKSQubit Technologies** is hiring **Mechanical Engineering Freshers** for multiple opportunities in **Mechanical Design, Production, and Quality Control**.

**Job Details**

* **Company:** AKSQubit Technologies
* **Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana
* **Job Type:** Full\-time
* **Work Mode:** On\-site
* **Experience:** 0–1 year
* **Qualification:** Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
* **Experience Level:** Freshers / Trainees
* **Number of Vacancies:** As per project requirements
* **Salary:** Rs. 10,000 \- 15,000 per month

**Open Positions**

***1\. Mechanical Design Engineer – Trainee/Fresher***

**Key Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of mechanical design and engineering drawings
* 2D drafting and 3D CAD software such as **AutoCAD, Creo, or similar**
* Understanding of manufacturing processes and product development
* Preparation of part drawings, assembly drawings, and BOMs
* Interest in customized machine and product design

***2\. Production Engineer – Trainee/Fresher***

**Key Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of **sheet metal fabrication and welding**
* Understanding of **CNC Milling, CNC Turning, and conventional machining**
* Knowledge of surface preparation, painting, and finishing
* Mechanical assembly and testing
* Production planning and shop\-floor coordination
* Reading and interpreting engineering drawings
* Vendor coordination and manufacturing follow\-up

***3\. Quality Control (QC) Engineer – Trainee/Fresher***

**Key Skills:**

* Understanding of engineering drawings and basic **GD\&T**
* Inspection of fabricated and machined components
* Dimensional inspection using measuring instruments
* Basic knowledge of quality standards and documentation
* Preparation of inspection reports
* Identification and reporting of non\-conformities
* Coordination with production teams for quality compliance

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong technical aptitude and problem\-solving skills
* Good communication and teamwork
* Willingness to learn and work in a hands\-on manufacturing environment
* Basic knowledge of **MS Office**
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality

**Industry Exposure**

Selected candidates will get exposure to:

* Customized Mechanical Product Development
* Special Purpose Machines (SPM)
* Industrial Automation Systems
* Robotics and AGV Platforms
* Precision Fabrication and Machining
* Mechanical Assembly and Testing
* Customer\-specific Engineering Solutions

**Who Can Apply?**

Fresh **Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech Mechanical Engineering graduates** who are interested in **mechanical design, production, fabrication, machining, quality control, and industrial product development** are encouraged to apply.

**Send your resume to aksqubittechnologies@gmail.com**

Location: Mumbai

  

Employment Type: Full\-Time

  

Work Mode\- Hybrid

  

Salary : 20,000\- 40,000 ( Fixed \+ Variable)

  

Experience\- 0 to 2 years

  

Probation Period: 6 Months

  

Makers’ Muse is a leading and fast\-growing EdTech organization on a mission to transform K–12 education through hands\-on STEM and future skills learning. We empower schools with cutting\-edge solutions like Robotics, Coding, AI, 3D Printing, Drones, and Design Thinking, making learning interactive, gamified, and practical. With successful partnerships across multiple states, our solutions are already making a difference in over 300\+ schools. Our passionate team works across functions like

  

content, product, sales, and tech — collaborating to deliver real\-world skills to students and educators.

  

? Website: https://makersmuse.in

  

A Business Development Executive will be responsible for driving EdTech product sales by targeting schools and institutes, conducting client meetings, and closing deals. The role requires strong communication and sales skills to generate leads, deliver impactful presentations, and achieve monthly revenue targets through effective relationship management.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Generating leads through telecalling and online research to connect with schools institutes, \& Parents
* Presenting EdTech products and services to potential clients and explaining key features
* Scheduling and coordinating product demos with school decision\-makers
* Following up with leads to ensure timely closures and achieve sales targets
* Maintaining accurate records of calls, leads, and conversions in CRM or Excel sheets
* Supporting the Sales Executive/Manager in daily sales operations and reporting
* Assisting in planning and executing promotional campaigns and school outreach activities
* Gathering feedback from schools to improve sales strategies and client engagement
### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* Freshers / Interns are welcome to apply \-with prior internship experience.
* 1\-2 year of experience for the entry levels in business development (EdTech experience is preferred).
* Ability to work independently and manage client relationships.
* Willingness to travel locally for client visits.

 **Work Requirements \& Conditions:**

  

* Work timings\- 9 Am to 6 Pm (Mon. to Sat) Personal laptop required
* Languages Required: English, Hindi.
* Ability to Travel locally and intercity
 **Skills**:

  

* Excellent communication (English \& regional language). Persuasion and negotiation skills.

title: Assistant Quality Manager
description:
**About Role:**

To lead and manage the Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Control activities, Internal Audits, Non\-Conformance Management, Customer Complaint Handling, KPI Monitoring, and EHS compliance to ensure organizational quality objectives, regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Quality Management System (QMS)**

* Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with AS9120, EMS, OH\&S, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Define and monitor departmental quality objectives aligned with organizational goals.
* Drive continual improvement initiatives across departments.

**2\. Quality Planning \& Risk Management**

* Prepare quality plans for new projects, products, and operational activities.
* Conduct risk assessments and identify mitigation strategies for quality\-related risks.
* Monitor process effectiveness and implement preventive measures.
* Ensure root cause analysis and corrective actions are effectively implemented.

**3\. Document Control \& Compliance**

* Manage quality documentation including SOPs, Work Instructions, Policies, Procedures, Formats, and Records.
* Ensure proper version control, approval, revision tracking, and accessibility of documents.
* Maintain centralized document control systems and ensure confidentiality where applicable.

**4\. Quality Control Operations**

* Oversee Incoming Material Inspection, In\-Process Inspection, and Final Product Inspection activities.
* Ensure products and materials comply with customer specifications and quality standards.
* Monitor inspection reports, test records, and quality data.
* Ensure timely identification and resolution of quality deviations.

**5\. Internal Audit Management**

* Prepare and execute annual internal audit plans and schedules.
* Conduct internal audits for Quality and EHS Management Systems.
* Review previous audit findings and pending non\-conformances.
* Issue audit reports, observations, and non\-conformance reports.
* Ensure timely closure and effectiveness of corrective actions.

**6\. Non\-Conformance \& Corrective Action Management**

* Lead investigation of non\-conformance incidents and customer complaints.
* Conduct root cause analysis using quality tools and methodologies.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Monitor effectiveness of corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
* Coordinate with internal departments, suppliers, customers, and external agencies for resolution.

**7\. Customer Complaint \& Quality Issue Handling**

* Manage customer quality concerns, complaints, feedback, and technical queries.
* Coordinate Return Material Authorization (RMA), scrap approvals, and customer notifications.
* Ensure complaint closure within defined timelines.
* Maintain customer satisfaction through timely communication and resolution.
* Prepare and share investigation and corrective action reports with customers when required.

**8\. Management Review Meeting (MRM)**

* Plan and conduct Management Review Meetings as per defined frequency.
* Prepare agendas, reports, presentations, and MOMs for review meetings.
* Monitor action items, target dates, and status updates.
* Escalate delays or critical quality issues to management.

**9\. KPI, MIS \& Performance Monitoring**

* Review departmental MIS reports and KPIs regularly.
* Identify performance gaps, deviations, and process inefficiencies.
* Raise non\-conformance where KPI targets are not achieved.
* Recommend process improvements and revised performance targets.

**10\. EHS Management Support**

* Monitor EMS and OH\&S related reports and KPIs.
* Ensure compliance with EHS requirements and reporting systems.
* Coordinate with Safety Officer and management on deviations and corrective actions.

**11\. Training \& Awareness**

* Conduct Quality, AS9120, EMS, and OH\&S awareness programs.
* Lead employee training related to quality systems and compliance.
* Promote organizational knowledge sharing and quality awareness culture.
* Support induction training for new employees

title: Business Development Officer
description:
We are looking for a motivated, confident, and result\-driven **Business Development Officer** to join our team. In this role, you will be the face of our company, responsible for driving B2B partnerships with schools, colleges, and other educational platforms. Your primary goal will be to sell our innovative educational products—including Tinkering Labs, specialized courses, and hands\-on workshops—while building and nurturing long\-term relationships with institutional clients. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys networking, sales conversations, and working in a fast\-paced growth environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Lead Generation \& Outreach**

Proactively identify, research, and generate new business opportunities with schools, colleges, universities, coaching centers, and other educational platforms.

Perform outbound activities including cold calling, warm calling, email outreach, LinkedIn networking, and in\-person visits to reach key decision\-makers.

Identify and connect with principals, directors, academic heads, placement officers, HODs, and training managers.

**2\. Product Pitching \& Sales**

Present and demonstrate the value of our products—Tinkering Labs, courses, and workshops—to potential institutional partners.

Conduct product demos, presentations, and awareness sessions for school/college management, faculty, and students.

Develop and deliver customized proposals, negotiate terms, and close partnership deals to achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

**3\. Partnership Development \& Relationship Management**

Convert leads into long\-term institutional partners through strategic collaborations and formal agreements (e.g., MoUs).

Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with institutional stakeholders to ensure client satisfaction, renewals, and upsell opportunities.

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned institutional partners.

**4\. Lead \& Pipeline Management**

Manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting to closure, including tracking all leads, follow\-ups, and activities.

Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of prospects, partner interactions, and sales activities in CRM tools or spreadsheets.

Regularly review and report on lead conversion metrics, pipeline health, and sales progress.

**5\. Market Intelligence \& Coordination**

Gather insights on market trends, competitor activities, and institutional needs to refine sales strategies.

Coordinate with internal product, delivery, and marketing teams to tailor offerings and ensure smooth program execution.

Represent the company at educational fairs, school/college visits, and regional marketing events.

description:
Job Description – Junior Ink Chemist (Fresher)Job Title

**Junior Ink Chemist**

Department

Research \& Development (R\&D) / Production

Reporting To

Senior Ink Chemist / R\&D Manager

Job Location

As Assigned

Job Summary

We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented **Junior Ink Chemist** to join our R\&D team. The ideal candidate should have a strong academic foundation in Chemistry and a keen interest in ink formulation, color science, and chemical manufacturing. Freshers with an **M.Sc. in Chemistry** are encouraged to apply. The selected candidate will receive on\-the\-job training in ink formulation, quality testing, and production support.

Key ResponsibilitiesResearch \& Development

* Assist in the development and improvement of printing ink formulations.
* Conduct laboratory experiments under the guidance of senior chemists.
* Prepare and document trial formulations and observations.
* Support new product development and formulation optimization.

Laboratory Testing

* Perform routine testing of ink samples for viscosity, color shade, drying time, gloss, adhesion, pH, and other quality parameters.
* Record and analyze test results accurately.
* Maintain laboratory equipment and ensure cleanliness of the work area.

Production Support

* Assist production during pilot and commercial batches.
* Support troubleshooting of product quality issues.
* Help monitor consistency of formulations during manufacturing.

Documentation

* Maintain formulation records, laboratory notebooks, and test reports.
* Prepare technical documentation and sample reports.
* Follow SOPs and maintain compliance with quality standards.

Safety \& Compliance

* Follow all laboratory safety procedures and chemical handling guidelines.
* Use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times.
* Ensure proper storage and handling of chemicals.

Educational Qualification

* **M.Sc. in Chemistry (Mandatory).**
* Specialization in Organic, Industrial, Polymer, Analytical, or Applied Chemistry will be preferred.

Experience

* **0–1 year (Freshers are welcome).**
* Internship or academic project in paints, inks, coatings, polymers, or specialty chemicals will be an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of chemistry fundamentals.
* Basic knowledge of laboratory techniques and analytical instruments.
* Good observation and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Willingness to learn ink formulation and manufacturing processes.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Knowledge

* Basic understanding of pigments, dyes, resins, solvents, and additives.
* Familiarity with quality testing procedures.
* Knowledge of laboratory safety practices.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy of laboratory testing and documentation.
* Learning and adaptation to formulation processes.
* Timely completion of assigned laboratory trials.
* Compliance with safety and quality procedures.
* Contribution to successful product development and production support.
* Attendance, discipline, and teamwork.

Career Growth

The selected candidate will undergo structured training in ink formulation, quality assurance, and manufacturing processes. Based on performance, the employee can progress to:

* Ink Chemist
* Senior Ink Chemist
* R\&D Executive
* Product Development Chemist
* Technical Service Chemist

Compensation \& Benefits

* Competitive salary as per industry standards.
* On\-the\-job technical training.
* Career growth opportunities in R\&D and manufacturing.
* PF, ESIC (as applicable), leave benefits, and other company benefits.

* Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications.

title: HR Assistant
description:
**Key HR Assistant Duties and Responsibilities**

Here are the most important HR assistant roles and responsibilities in a typical organization:

**1\. Administrative Support**

A core part of HR assistant duties and responsibilities includes performing administrative tasks such as maintaining employee records, preparing HR documents, filing paperwork, and updating internal databases. Attention to detail is essential to ensure accuracy and confidentiality.

**2\. Recruitment Assistance**

HR Assistants often help with posting job ads, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and communicating with candidates. They support recruiters and HR managers throughout the hiring process, making recruitment more efficient.

**3\. Onboarding and Orientation**

One of the essential HR assistant responsibilities is facilitating the onboarding process for new hires. This includes preparing orientation materials, organizing welcome sessions, and ensuring all necessary paperwork is completed.

**4\. Employee Records and HRIS Management**

HR Assistants maintain accurate records in Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS). They input and update employee data, track attendance, and manage leave requests to ensure smooth HR operations.

**5\. Compliance and Policy Support**

Another important aspect of HR assistant duties and responsibilities is helping to ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies. HR Assistants may assist in audits, prepare reports, and help implement HR policies.

**6\. Employee Support and Communication**

As a point of contact for employee questions about HR policies, benefits, or procedures, HR Assistants must have good communication skills. They ensure smooth internal communication and help resolve minor issues before they escalate.

description:
Lead, conduct, and oversee Corporate Investigations (“CI”) arising out of alleged misconduct raised through Accenture’s various CoBE reporting channels.


Reporting to Conduct \& Ethics Regional Lead \- Corporate Investigator, manages notification, recording and reporting process related to investigations, and works with senior company leadership to assess and address significant legal risks associated with such reports and investigations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Actively assist and/or conduct investigations of CI and personnel\-related allegations of misconduct registered through Accenture’s various reporting channels.
* Oversee and conduct legally privileged investigations (at the direction of an attorney), which includes, defining scope, reviewing documentation, developing investigative plan, notifying appropriate personnel, conducting interviews, compiling investigation status and reports, recommending, and implementing proper remedial measures, concluding matters appropriately.
* Provide advice to organizational leadership concerning risk and appropriate remedial measures related to CI allegations.
* Collaborate with internal and external resources assembled to address and resolve allegations of misconduct or allegations of other improper processes/practices.
* Oversee, counsel, guide, train and support attorneys and other investigative personnel assembled to conduct CI\-related investigations.
* Draft and/or review analyses to address risks of CI\-related misconduct.
* Consult with and advise HR leadership concerning nature, risks, investigation and remediation of matters.
* Work with regional Corporate Investigators, Geographic Legal and HR Leads, Global and Regional Leads of internal functions, and other Global leadership on investigations.
* Stay abreast of legal developments affecting investigations, rights of reporting individuals, rights of accused, and compliance\-related standards.
* Promptly identify and escalate CI matters to Regional Leads for oversight.
* Develop internal guidelines on CI\-investigation related issues.

**Relationships****:**

Reports to: Relevant Conduct \& Ethics Regional Lead or Other Senior Conduct \& Ethics Regional Leader.

  



Supervises: Collaborate with local HR/ER/Legal professionals to effectuate investigations.


  

* Strong interpersonal skills, strategic business acumen, confidence and capability in addressing sensitive and complicated ethical conduct/compliance and personnel\-related matters.
* Experience and demonstrated capability in conducting and supervising investigations (including compliance\-related investigations, employment investigations, POSH, and governmental investigations) and in drafting confidential reports and advising senior leadership on such risks.
* In\-depth knowledge of local ethical/conduct/compliance\-related risks, employee rights and obligations (including POSH, LGBTQIA\+, PWD, HIV et al), and related laws.
* Extensive experience in employee relations and workplace investigations.
* Team oriented, yet able to work independently.
* Experienced to work in a multi\-national and culturally diverse environment.
* Ability to significantly influence senior executive management decisions; commands respect of executives.
* Ability to present careful, balanced, objective, lawful and well\-reasoned solutions.
* Responsive and follows through on commitments.
* Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.
* Ability to influence, strong executive presence.
* Excellent oral and written communications.

* Bachelor of Law or Higher degree.
* Demonstrable experience in conducting workplace/POSH and other investigations.

**Skills \& Work Experience**:

  



For CL7:

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Employment Law Experience is preferred but not mandatory.

* Demonstratable experience and capability in conducting and supervising investigations (including compliance\-related investigations, employment investigations, POSH and governmental investigations) and in drafting confidential reports and advising senior leadership on such risks.

* In\-depth knowledge of local ethical/conduct/compliance\-related risks, employee rights and obligations, and related laws, including but not limited to Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition \& Redressal) Act, 2013 and Rules framed thereunder.

**Responsibilities :**  

**Leadership and Team Management:**  

Provide overall leadership for site construction activities, supervising multidisciplinary teams and ensuring efficient execution.
  
Conduct regular site reviews, evaluate contractor performance, and hold weekly review meetings to track progress and address bottlenecks.
  
Ensure smooth coordination between site personnel and head office teams for project\-related deliverables.
  
  

**Client and Stakeholder Coordination:**  

Serve as the primary interface with the client for all site\-related activities, maintaining effective communication and resolving issues promptly.
  
Participate in client meetings, provide updates, and ensure alignment with contractual obligations and project milestones.
  
  

**Contract and Commercial Management:**  

Review and interpret contract documentation to ensure construction activities are aligned with terms and conditions.
  
Manage billing processes including preparation, certification, and submission of construction bills, as well as follow\-up for client payments.
  
Oversee contractor bill reconciliation, client bill reconciliation, and final contract closure activities.
  
Ensure accurate material reconciliation, identification of surplus materials, and coordination with the head office for redistribution.
  
  

**Compliance and Safety Management:**  

Ensure strict adherence to safety regulations, company HSE policies, and client\-specific safety protocols.
  
Oversee HR and statutory compliance activities in accordance with client requirements and legal regulations.
  
Promote labor welfare practices and maintain a safe, compliant, and productive work environment.
  
Conduct weekly and monthly meetings with respective contractors and safety personnel.
  
  

**Project and Asset Management:**  

Oversee all aspects of site construction, including pre\-commissioning and commissioning activities.
  
Ensure periodic maintenance and accountability of site assets, with inspections carried out at defined intervals (e.g., once every three months).
  
Drive effective planning and resource allocation across multiple construction disciplines to achieve project targets.
  
  

**Requirements :**  

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or a related discipline).
  
Expertise in site construction management across multiple engineering disciplines.
  
Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, verification, and contract administration.
  
Familiarity with HR compliance requirements, statutory regulations, and labor welfare practices.
  
Strong understanding of safety standards, regulations, and best practices for construction sites.
  
Effective leadership, team management, and stakeholder coordination skills.
  
Financial acumen in billing, reconciliation, and payment follow\-up processes.
  
Proactive planning of activities and ability to guide and support fellow site team members.
  
Minimum of 20 years of experience in site construction management, with proven expertise in handling large\-scale, multidisciplinary projects.
  
Relevant certifications in project management, construction safety, contract management, or related technical domains are preferred.
  
  

Gradiant is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Factory HR Manager
description:
Location: Bangalore \- Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.


Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.**Description :**


The Plant HR Head is responsible for leading Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Labour Relations, statutory compliance, workforce planning, talent management, employee engagement, and HR operations for the manufacturing plant. The role partners with Plant Leadership to align people strategies with business objectives while ensuring industrial harmony, workforce productivity, legal compliance, operational excellence, and organizational effectiveness.

**Missions and responsibilities :**

**The job holder is responsible for the following activities**

**1\. Strategic HR Leadership**

* Partner with Plant Leadership to develop and execute people strategies aligned with business and manufacturing objectives.
* Drive workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, succession planning, capability development, employee engagement, and change management initiatives.
* Lead HR transformation, automation, digitalization, and Industry 4\.0 readiness initiatives.
* Act as a trusted advisor on organization design, culture, workforce capability, and people strategy.
* Manage HR budgets, workforce plans, and people metrics to support business decisions.

**2\. Industrial Relations \& Labour Relations**

* Develop and implement Industrial Relations strategies to maintain a stable, productive, and disruption\-free manufacturing environment.
* Build and sustain effective relationships with trade unions, employee representatives, and workmen.
* Lead collective bargaining, wage negotiations, productivity\-linked settlements, and long\-term agreements.
* Ensure compliance with Certified Standing Orders/Model Standing Orders, settlements, awards, and employment conditions.
* Represent management before Labour Authorities, Conciliation Officers, Labour Courts, Industrial Tribunals, and statutory forums.
* Manage grievances, disciplinary matters, misconduct investigations, domestic enquiries, and conflict resolution in accordance with principles of natural justice.
* Coach managers on employee relations and disciplinary processes.
* Monitor industrial relations climate and implement proactive interventions to prevent industrial unrest and ensure business continuity.

**3\. Labour Law, Statutory Compliance \& Government Liaison**


Ensure compliance with all applicable labour legislation, including:

* Code on Wages, 2019
* Industrial Relations Code, 2020
* Code on Social Security, 2020
* Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (OSH) Code, 2020
* POSH Act, 2013
* Apprentices Act, 1961
* Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act
* Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act
* Applicable Central and State Rules, notifications, amendments, and employment laws.
* Responsibilities include:
* Ensuring compliance relating to wages, overtime, working hours, leave, welfare provisions, statutory benefits, and employment conditions.
* Maintaining statutory registers, licences, records, notices, and returns.
* Coordinating inspections, audits, and regulatory submissions with Labour Department, Directorate of Factories, EPFO, ESIC, and other authorities.
* Monitoring legislative developments, conducting compliance audits, and implementing corrective actions and risk mitigation measures.
* Maintaining effective relationships with labour authorities, statutory bodies, and government agencies.

**4\. Factory HR Operations \& Contract Labour Management**

* Lead workforce planning and manpower deployment across shifts and operations.
* Manage recruitment, onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and separations.
* Oversee permanent, fixed\-term, apprentice, trainee, and contract workforce administration.
* Ensure effective management of payroll coordination, attendance, leave administration, HRIS, employee records, wages, overtime, incentives, shift allowances, statutory deductions, and employee benefits.
* Fulfil Principal Employer obligations and ensure contractor compliance with labour laws.
* Conduct contract labour audits covering wages, statutory contributions, bonus, leave, welfare provisions, licences, and statutory documentation.
* Monitor contractor performance, workforce deployment, productivity, and labour costs.

**5\. Talent Management, Performance \& Employee Engagement**

* Lead talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership development, learning initiatives, and workforce capability building.
* Build talent pipelines for critical manufacturing, engineering, technical, and leadership positions.
* Drive performance management, goal setting, development planning, promotions, merit increases, incentive schemes, and bonus administration.
* Monitor labour costs and compensation competitiveness.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, recognition, welfare, diversity, and inclusion initiatives.
* Lead shop\-floor engagement programs including suggestion schemes, quality circles, communication forums, and cultural initiatives.
* Foster an ethical, inclusive, and high\-performance culture supported by grievance redressal and whistleblower mechanisms.

**6\. Health, Safety, Analytics \& Team Leadership**

* Partner with HSE teams to strengthen workplace safety culture and statutory compliance.
* Support occupational health, employee wellbeing, welfare programs, safety committees, and incident investigations.
* Ensure compliance relating to welfare facilities, occupational health requirements, medical examinations, and statutory safety provisions.
* Develop HR dashboards and provide insights on attrition, absenteeism, labour productivity, overtime utilization, labour costs, recruitment effectiveness, training outcomes, employee engagement, diversity, contract labour utilization, compliance status, and workforce planning.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Plant HR team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement

**Skills and competences requirements:**

**1\.Skill Requirements**

* Working in a Matrix
* Employee \& industrial relations management
* Labor law and statutory compliance
* Talent acquisition and workforce planning
* Conflict resolution and negotiation
* Team leadership and mentoring
* Data\-driven decision making and HR analytics

**2\. Technical Competencies**

* SAP, Oracle, Workday, or equivalent HRIS platforms.( Desirable)
* HR Analytics and Dashboard Reporting.
* Microsoft Office Suite.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Law, Labour Welfare, or related discipline.
* MBA/master’s degree in human resources, Industrial Relations, Labour Welfare, Personnel Management, or related field preferred.
* Professional HR or Industrial Relations certifications will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant manufacturing or industrial experience.
* Minimum 10 years in Plant HR leadership roles.
* Strong expertise in Industrial Relations, Labour Relations, collective bargaining, labour law compliance, statutory compliance, workforce management, and employee relations.
* Proven experience managing unionized workforces, government inspections, wage settlements, disciplinary processes, and organizational change initiatives.


At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: HR Head
description:
**About Greenr**

Greenr Café is one of India’s leading plant\-based restaurant brands, built on a simple idea we want to make conscious dining feel easy, exciting, and everyday.

We care about good food, great coffee, and spaces where people genuinely enjoy being. As we grow across cities, we’re not just opening new outlets we’re building a team and culture that can grow with us, without losing what makes Greenr special.

We’re looking for an **HR Head / HR Manager** who can help us bring structure to our people practices, build strong teams, and create a workplace where people feel supported, trusted, and excited to grow.

**Role Overview**

You’ll be the person who owns HR at Greenr helping us put the right systems, habits, and culture in place as we scale. From hiring and onboarding to performance, engagement, compliance, and learning you’ll be shaping how people experience Greenr every day.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys building things, not just managing them. Someone who can think long\-term, but is also comfortable jumping in and solving things on the ground when needed.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build simple, clear HR systems and policies that actually work in a fast\-growing business
* Set up structure across the employee journey from hiring someone to their growth and exit
* Make HR processes smoother and more organized through better tools and systems
* Lead hiring for both restaurant teams and corporate roles, and help us attract the right people consistently
* Improve how we hire making it faster, more structured, and more thoughtful
* Create onboarding experiences that help new team members feel welcome and confident from day one
* Build engagement and retention initiatives so people feel connected to Greenr and want to stay and grow here
* Set up a performance system that is simple, fair, and actually used—focused on goals, feedback, and regular conversations
* Work closely with managers to build a culture where feedback and development are part of everyday work
* Identify strong performers and help them grow into bigger roles over time
* Ensure all HR compliance is in place (labour laws, POSH, payroll coordination, documentation, etc.)
* Keep HR data clean, updated, and easy to use for decision\-making
* Build training and learning programs that help teams improve in their roles and grow professionally
* Partner with founders and leadership to plan hiring needs as we open new outlets
* Support new store launches with hiring, onboarding, and making sure teams are ready to go
* Continuously improve HR systems based on what the business actually needs as it grows

**What We’re Looking ForEducation**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of HR experience in F\&B, Hospitality, Retail, or HoReCa
* At least 1–2 years in a lead HR role (HR Manager / HR Head or similar)
* Experience working across multiple locations is a strong plus
* Experience building HR processes or systems from scratch is highly valued

**Skills \& Mindset**

* Strong understanding of HR operations, compliance, and labour laws
* Comfortable building structure in fast\-moving, sometimes unstructured environments
* Strong people instincts especially in hiring and team building
* Good communicator who can work with everyone from founders to frontline teams
* Comfortable using HR tools and systems (or quick to learn them)

**What You’ll Get**

* A chance to build the HR function of a fast\-growing, purpose\-driven brand from the ground up
* Real ownership—you won’t just run HR, you’ll shape it
* Direct access to founders and leadership, and a voice in how the company grows
* The opportunity to design systems that will define Greenr’s future as we scale
* Exposure to multi\-city operations and real, on\-ground business building
* A fast\-paced, collaborative, and very hands\-on work environment
* Competitive compensation with growth linked to impact and ownership
* Most importantly—the chance to build a workplace where people feel proud, supported, and excited to come to work every day

**Location:** Delhi NCR (with travel across Greenr locations as needed)

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹53,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: HR Executive
description:
Job Title: HR Executive

**Location:** Hyderabad, India  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience Required:** 1–2 Years Minimum  
**Industry:** Information Technology (IT)  
**Preference:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

About Us

Skygoaltech is a leading provider of digital solutions aimed at enhancing businesses' online and mobile presence. Our services include website design and development, mobile application development, branding, digital marketing, payment solutions, and ongoing support and maintenance. With a proven track record of serving over 100 clients globally, our expert team is committed to helping businesses achieve their digital transformation goals and remain competitive in today's evolving market.

Key Roles \& ResponsibilitiesTalent Acquisition \& Recruitment

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for internal and client hiring requirements.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, and recruitment agencies.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
* Schedule interviews and maintain communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Negotiate salary packages and release offer letters.
* Coordinate pre\-boarding activities and ensure smooth candidate onboarding.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for future hiring needs.
* Coordinate with external recruitment consultants and staffing partners.
* Track recruitment metrics and prepare hiring reports.

Employee Onboarding \& Offboarding

* Manage complete onboarding process for new employees.
* Conduct employee induction and orientation programs.
* Collect and verify employee documents.
* Create employee records and maintain HR documentation.
* Coordinate IT asset allocation, email creation, and system access.
* Handle employee confirmation and probation review processes.
* Manage resignation, exit interviews, full and final settlement coordination, and relieving documentation.
* Coordinate asset recovery during employee exit.

Employee Lifecycle Management

* Maintain employee database and HRMS records.
* Prepare employment contracts, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, and relieving letters.
* Handle employee promotions, transfers, designation changes, and salary revisions.
* Maintain employee personal files and statutory records.

Payroll \& Compensation

* Coordinate monthly payroll processing.
* Verify attendance, leave records, and payroll inputs before salary processing.
* Manage employee reimbursements, incentives, bonuses, variable pay, stipends, and contractor payments.
* Coordinate with payroll vendors to ensure timely salary disbursement.
* Resolve employee payroll\-related queries.

Attendance \& Leave Management

* Monitor daily attendance and working hours.
* Manage leave applications, approvals, and leave balance records.
* Ensure compliance with attendance policies.
* Coordinate biometric and attendance management systems.
* Generate attendance and leave reports for management.

Statutory Compliance

* Handle Employee Provident Fund (EPF) registration and compliance.
* Coordinate PF registrations, UAN generation, and employee KYC.
* Monitor PF contributions and resolve EPFO\-related issues.
* Coordinate PF transfers, withdrawals, and exit formalities.
* Ensure compliance with statutory labour regulations.
* Coordinate Professional Tax (PT) compliance and statutory deductions.
* Assist in TDS\-related employee documentation and payroll compliance.

Employee Relations \& Engagement

* Address employee concerns and grievances professionally.
* Promote a positive and healthy workplace culture.
* Organize employee engagement activities, celebrations, and team\-building events.
* Support employee wellness initiatives.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and maintain healthy employee relationships.

Performance Management

* Coordinate probation reviews and employee confirmations.
* Support performance appraisal cycles.
* Maintain performance records and documentation.
* Coordinate feedback collection from reporting managers.

HR Operations \& Administration

* Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies and SOPs.
* Prepare HR reports and dashboards for management.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.
* Coordinate with department heads regarding manpower planning.
* Support management in strategic HR initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and labour laws.
* Handle HR audits and documentation.

Background Verification \& Documentation

* Coordinate background verification (BGV) of candidates.
* Verify employment history, educational qualifications, and references.
* Prepare authorization letters and HR\-related official documents.
* Maintain employee compliance documentation.

Training \& Development

* Coordinate employee training and development programs.
* Identify learning and development requirements.
* Track training completion and employee development initiatives.

HR Communication

* Draft professional HR communications, circulars, policy updates, and employee announcements.
* Prepare HR\-related emails and official correspondence.

description:
Recruiting Manager – US Recruitment (Hands\-On)

  

Company: Infinite Computer Solutions (ICS)


Location: India (Bangalore / Hyderabad / Noida/Delhi or other ICS location) \- Remote


Shift: EST hours (US Recruitment Shift) — typically evening/night shift IST


Department: Talent Acquisition

  

Infinite Computer Solutions is a global technology services company founded in 2001, headquartered in Rockville, Maryland (USA), with over 20,000 professionals across 20\+ global locations. ICS delivers digital engineering, AI\-enabled transformation, cloud, product engineering, and application development services to clients in telecom, healthcare, banking, media, and hi\-tech.

  

Job Summary

  

ICS is seeking a hands\-on Recruiting Manager based in India to both lead a team of recruiters and personally source, screen, and close candidates for US\-based technology requirements. This is a player\-coach role: alongside managing the team, the person will carry their own requisitions and directly engage candidates and clients. The role operates during EST hours to align with US hiring managers, clients, and delivery teams, and owns recruiting strategy, team performance, and outreach effectiveness across ICS's core practice areas — digital engineering, cloud, AI\-enabled transformation, and application development.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Personally own and work a portfolio of open requisitions end\-to\-end — sourcing, screening, submitting, and closing candidates — in addition to managing the team (hands\-on, player\-coach role)
* Manage, coach, and develop a team of US recruiters/sources operating on EST hours from India
* Own recruiting metrics for US requisitions: time\-to\-fill, submission\-to\-interview ratio, offer\-acceptance rate, and pipeline health
* Partner directly with US\-based hiring managers, account managers, and delivery leads to understanding role requirements and align sourcing strategy
* Make cold calls and conduct candidate outreach directly during peak hiring periods or on critical/urgent requisitions
* Develop and refine cold\-calling scripts, email templates, and outreach cadences for engaging US technology candidates (W2, C2C, 1099\)
* Build sourcing strategy across US\-focused channels: Dice, CareerBuilder, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Monster, ATS/CRM databases, referrals
* Ensure team understanding of US work authorization types (H1B, GC, OPT/CPT, US Citizen) and visa/tax term nuances (W2, C2C, 1099\)
* Review and approve candidate submissions before presenting to US hiring managers or clients
* Monitor recruiter productivity and pipeline volume across the EST shift; rebalance requisitions as needed
* Ensure compliance with US employment/EEO guidelines as applicable to submissions and outreach
* Report recruiting KPIs to US\-based TA leadership and recommend process/tooling improvements
* Act as the primary India\-based point of contact for US stakeholders during EST working hours
* Coordinate with global ICS recruiting teams to ensure smooth handoffs and consistent candidate experience

title: Site Manager - Global Capability Center, Chennai
description:
**DHL Group** the logistics provider of the world with over 580,000 employees in more than 220 countries and territories. We are an organization that is not just moving goods around, we have a very clear purpose, and we are: Connecting People. Improving Lives. We provide challenges and opportunities for personal and professional development; we recognize the difference you bring to our business and together we share the pride of building one of the largest world leaders in logistics and supply chain.


Are you an idea generator who is passionate about innovation and dynamic markets? Do you enjoy developing business and driving projects forward? Are you looking for a responsible position where you can actively help shape the future? Then we should get to know each other!


Become part of a unique corporate culture defined by a respectful working environment, inspiring colleagues, strong team spirit, and a hands\-on mentality. Join us and bring your ideas to life!


We are currently establishing a **Shared Service Center (SSC) for the German\-speaking market**, focusing on the delivery of high\-quality, transactional and operational support services across multiple business functions. Our goal is to build scalable, efficient, and standardized processes that support areas such as **HR, Customer Service, Sales, and other corporate functions** with their back\-office activities.


As the Site Manager Global Capability Center Chennai (GCC) you will lead the strategic setup, scaling, and operational excellence of the organization's Global Capability Center, serving as a centralized hub delivering shared services, technology, analytics, and process support across the company's global logistics and supply chain operations. This role combines strategic leadership, operational management, stakeholder engagement, and talent development to build a high\-performing center that drives efficiency, innovation, and cost optimization for the parent organization.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Strategic Leadership**


* Support defining and execute the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the GCC in alignment with global business objectives
* Identify and onboard new functions/processes for migration to the GCC (finance, IT, network planning, customer support, procurement, data analytics, engineering, sales back office) and manage recruiting activities individually
* Build the business case for center expansion, including cost\-benefit analysis and ROI projections
* Represent the GCC in global leadership forums and act as the bridge between local operations and global headquarters

* **Operations \& Service Delivery**


* Own end\-to\-end service delivery across all functions housed in the GCC, ensuring adherence to SLAs/KPIs
* Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement (Lean/Six Sigma, RPA, AI\-led transformation)
* Oversee transition and migration of new processes from global locations to the GCC with minimal disruption
* Ensure robust governance frameworks, risk management, and business continuity planning
* Ensure KPI definition and thorough monitoring for each acitivity

* **Technology \& Digital Transformation**


* Partner with global IT/Digital teams to embed automation, AI/ML, and analytics capabilities into logistics operations (route optimization, freight visibility, warehouse management systems, TMS/WMS support)
* Champion digital transformation initiatives that enhance supply chain visibility and operational efficiency
* Evaluate and implement emerging technologies relevant to logistics (IoT, predictive analytics, control towers)

* **Talent \& Organization Building**


* Build and lead a multi\-disciplinary leadership team across functional towers
* Develop talent acquisition, retention, and career development strategies to position the GCC as an employer of choice
* Foster a high\-performance culture, drive employee engagement, and manage change through rapid scaling
* Design organizational structure, span of control, and career pathways aligned to global standards

* **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**


* Serve as primary point of contact for global business unit heads, ensuring alignment on priorities and expectations
* Manage relationships with external vendors, technology partners, and outsourcing providers where applicable
* Negotiate and manage service level agreements (SLAs) and commercial contracts

* **Financial Management**


* Own the P\&L / cost center budget for the GCC
* Drive cost optimization and efficiency targets while maintaining service quality
* Report on cost savings, productivity gains, and value delivered to global stakeholders

* **Compliance \& Risk**


* Ensure adherence to local labor laws, data privacy regulations (GDPR, local data protection laws), and industry compliance standards
* Implement information security and data governance frameworks in coordination with global InfoSec teams
* Manage regulatory relationships with local authorities (SEZ/STPI approvals where relevant)

**Key Requirements**


**Education**


* Minimum: Bachelor's along Postgraduate degree in any discipline.
* + Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field (mandatory)
	+ MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree preferred

**Experience**


* 18 to 20\+ years of progressive experience in Global logistics, supply chain, or shared services/GCC leadership
* Minimum 10\+ years in a senior leadership role managing large, multi\-functional teams
* Prior experience setting up or scaling a GCC/GBS/shared services center strongly preferred
* Experience within logistics, freight forwarding, e\-commerce logistics, or supply chain technology companies preferred
* International experience
* Must have Business proficiency in English – written and spoken
* Good to have : German Language proficiency

**Skills \& Competencies**


* Strong strategic and business acumen with P\&L ownership experience
* Proven track record of large\-scale operational transformation and process migration
* Deep understanding of logistics operations (freight, warehousing, last\-mile, TMS/WMS, network planning)
* Detailed view on process details and continuous process improvements
* Strong knowledge of automation/RPA, analytics, and digital transformation in supply chain
* Excellent stakeholder management skills across cultures and geographies
* People leadership: talent development, organization design, change management
* Strong financial and commercial acumen.
* Excellent communication and executive presence for board/C\-suite interactions

**Working Conditions:**


* **Schedule:** Standard Indian business hours.
* **Work Model:** On‑site, occasional travel within India and abroad
* **Global Collaboration:** May require occasional work outside of standard hours.
* **Performance Metrics:** Success measured through response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction scores as well as meeting the budget and business case targets

**Benefits:**


* **Annual Leave**: 42 days of paid leave in addition to public/national holidays.

Employee Experience

Learning \& Development  

  

Employee Engagement  

  

HR Business Partnering

Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills.

Data\-driven approach with experience using HR analytics to support business decisions.

We are seeking an energetic and target\-driven **Bench Sales Recruiter** with 1–3 years of experience in IT staffing. Company Overview
  
  

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  

Job Overview
  
  

Milestone Technologies is seeking a forward\-thinking Talent Acquisition leader to own Talent Acquisition strategy and execution across the APAC region. This role is ideal for a people\-centric, strategic leader who pairs operational excellence and advanced recruiting analytics with a thoughtful, responsible approach to AI.
  
  

As Associate Director, Talent Acquisition – APAC, you will have regional ownership for all hiring strategy, delivery, and recruiter leadership across the Asia‑Pacific region, partnering closely with global TA leadership, regional business leaders and People Experience (PX) leaders. You are responsible for leading hiring initiatives across all talent categories including employee, contractor, and vendor engagements.
  
  

You bring a curious, innovative, problem‑solving mindset and a passion for modernizing recruiting practices through data and technology. As an inspirational people leader, you have demonstrated experience developing high‑performing teams while serving as a trusted, influential partner to senior stakeholders through clear communication and disciplined execution. You will lead and develop a team of full‑cycle recruiters, drive adoption of AI powered platforms such as LinkedIn Hiring Assistant, market‑specific recruiting tools such as Naukri, and utilize LLMs to ensure consistent, high‑quality hiring outcomes across the region. Your focus is on using technology as an enabler to enhance human judgement, elevate candidate experiences, and deliver better hiring outcomes at scale.
  
  

This role reports to the Senior Director of Global Talent Acquisition and Strategy and serves as the primary Talent Acquisition leader for APAC.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Regional Talent Leadership (APAC)
  
Own and lead end‑to‑end Talent Acquisition strategy for the APAC region, aligned to business growth, workforce planning, and digital transformation goals
  
Act as the primary TA advisor to APAC business leaders, PX partners, and global stakeholders
  
Balance global standards with regional market nuance, cultural considerations, and local hiring dynamics
  
Lead, coach, and develop a high‑performing APAC recruiting team
  
Build recruiter capability in AI‑assisted recruiting practices, analytics, and consultative hiring support
  
Drive adoption of new technologies through strong change management and continuous learning
  
Enabled Sourcing \& Market Intelligence
  
Leverage AI Sourcing tools, LinkedIn Hiring Assistant, and regional platforms such as Naukri to build strong, diverse, and scalable talent pipelines
  
Apply LLMs and generative AI to enhance sourcing strategies, candidate engagement, screening insights, and competitive intelligence
  
Continuously analyze regional labor markets, skill availability, and hiring trends using AI‑supported tools
  
Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve recruiter productivity through intelligent automation
  
Data, Metrics \& Insights
  
Define and manage recruiting KPIs for the region (including but not limited to time‑to‑fill, quality of hire, funnel conversion, candidate experience, offer acceptance)
  
Use data to surface insights, identify risks, and guide data‑driven decision‑making
  
Present clear, actionable insights to regional and global leadership
  
Candidate \& Stakeholder Experience
  
Ensure delivery of a consistent, inclusive, and high‑quality candidate experience across the APAC region
  
Build strong partnerships with business leaders, HR, and global TA counterparts
  
Champion Milestone’s people‑first culture while scaling hiring through technology
  
Contractor and Vendor Strategy
  
Own contractor and vendor hiring strategy across the region, ensuring alignment with workforce plans, compliance requirements, and cost controls
  
Manage and optimize relationships with external staffing vendors and MSP partners, driving performance, accountability, and consistent hiring outcomes
  
  

Desired Experience \& Qualifications
  
  

12\+ years of experience recruiting technical and operational talent across multiple APAC countries
  
6\+ years of people management experience leading recruiting teams
  
6\+ years of agency recruiting experience (required)
  
3\+ years vendor management experience
  
Proven experience scaling recruiting operations in regional or global environments
  
Demonstrated success implementing or leveraging AI‑enabled recruiting tools and sourcing platforms
  
Strong expertise in recruiting metrics, analytics, and operating with data‑driven discipline
  
Proficiency with ATS and HCM platforms; Taleo, Bullhorn, or Workday strongly preferred
  
Proficiency with LinkedIn Hiring Assistant, Naukri, and LLM tools
  
High proficiency with MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Outlook)

title: Specialist – Talent Sourcing
description:
### **About Us**


Global, inclusive and innovative \- welcome to AMS, where talent connects across cultures and backgrounds to shape the future of work.



We work with leading organizations to design and deliver talent strategies that bring together people, process, data and technology, helping millions of people find meaningful work every year. Our diverse, connected community collaborates to create results for clients and opportunities for our people to learn, grow and make an impact.



At AMS, we look for people who bring more than experience, and we welcome different perspectives and ways of thinking.

### **The Role**


Talent Sourcers play a key role in our clients’ success by partnering with Hiring Managers and Recruiters and developing effective, consultative, professional relationships with them. Through asking the right questions to ensure a detailed understanding of the client and each role, and by leveraging data, historic hiring trends, and market analysis, Talent Sourcers develop bespoke sourcing strategies and then use a range of tools and techniques to find the best talent in the market. Talent Sourcers are brand ambassadors for our clients, bringing each opportunity to life with candidates in a compelling and authentic way to ensure they are qualified, interested, and engaged before being presented to the Hiring Manager. A Lead Sourcing Specialist supports clients in hiring specialist and niche talent and will work on some of the more complex hiring needs that require strong business partnering skills and innovative approaches to finding and engaging with in\-demand candidates.

### **Key Accountabilities**

*Act as a Trusted Adviser*


* Work with Recruiters to develop partnerships and working relationships that deliver a great candidate and hiring manager experience.
* Leverage your existing experience, knowledge, and resources whilst also working with experts in sourcing and talent intelligence to develop effective sourcing strategies that enable you to deliver great candidates and lead and influence conversations with your hiring managers.
* Provide subject matter expertise, thought leadership, and talent intelligence in recruitment discussions and vacancy briefing calls with Hiring Managers, leaving the discussion with a detailed understanding of the client’s business, the requirements, and unique selling points of the role.
* Show tact and confidence in talking to client stakeholders. Ensure you’re leveraging your knowledge and wider AMS network to propose solutions that deliver the right results for your clients and AMS e.g., proposing alternative ways to find niche skills in a competitive market.
* Be accountable for the delivery of high\-quality, engaged candidate shortlists to your Hiring Managers with accurate and complete information to help them make informed hiring decisions. As a Trusted Advisor, make clear recommendations on your shortlisted candidates.
* Work with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to understand and share candidate feedback, challenges, and successes, advocating potential solutions and making recommendations to inform and adapt the recruitment strategy e.g., hiring in alternative locations, exploring different talent pools, or updating job descriptions.


*Attract, Source \& Engage High\-Calibre Talent*


* Demonstrate innovative, critical thinking and a commitment to ongoing professional development within your role, so you can support your client to hire the best talent in the market, not just those who are actively on the market.
* Review and post compelling, accurate job adverts that amplify your client’s brand and attract candidates to review and apply.
* Use your knowledge and established network at AMS to develop a sourcing strategy that uses the right channels to attract and engage with your target audience e.g., LinkedIn or other social media tools.
* Understand and utilise data to measure the success of your sourcing strategy, review, refine, innovate, and adapt your approach as required.
* Engage with your target audience in a professional and authentic way. Communicate effectively using various channels e.g., email, LinkedIn, social media, and over the phone. Expect to headhunt niche talent regularly for specialist hiring needs.
* Have high\-quality, consultative conversations with your candidates, qualifying their suitability for current or future roles.
* Gain insight into candidate skills, background, behaviours, career aspirations, and motivations and use this to make informed selection decisions.
* Support candidates, keeping them up to date as they progress through the recruitment process. Actively work with your candidates to talent pool them and create lasting relationships that enable you to re\-engage them to support future hiring needs.
* Present candidates to clients in an accurate and compelling way. Partner with hiring managers and recruiters to ensure that you’re continually considering diverse pools of talent and advocating for selection decisions and processes that are free from bias.
* Track progress, data, and performance on all applicable systems.

### **Skills \& Requirements**


Talent Sourcers play a key role in our clients’ success by partnering with Hiring Managers and Recruiters and developing effective, consultative, professional relationships with them. Through asking the right questions to ensure a detailed understanding of the client and each role, and by leveraging data, historic hiring trends, and market analysis, Talent Sourcers develop bespoke sourcing strategies and then use a range of tools and techniques to find the best talent in the market. Talent Sourcers are brand ambassadors for our clients, bringing each opportunity to life with candidates in a compelling and authentic way to ensure they are qualified, interested, and engaged before being presented to the Hiring Manager. A Lead Sourcing Specialist supports clients in hiring specialist and niche talent and will work on some of the more complex hiring needs that require strong business partnering skills and innovative approaches to finding and engaging with in\-demand candidates.

### **Why AMS?**


At AMS, we come from every walk of life \- and that’s what makes us unique. Our culture is open, inclusive and built on trust. We empower our people with the flexibility and autonomy to work in ways that bring out their best. We offer career opportunities in every direction you want to explore.



**We offer**


* Growth and development focused on your strengths
* The opportunity to develop a career within one of the world’s leading organisations specialising in talent and workforce solutions.
* A team that values being Passionate, Bold, and Authentic
* Supportive communities such as our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
* Volunteer day \- you get one additional paid day off each year to volunteer for a cause that matters to you
* A competitive reward and benefits package\* (private medical care, life insurance, etc.)
* Flexibility in how and where you work\*
* Hybrid model \[when applies \- details]

  


* Details may vary slightly depending on your location, local labour law, etc.

  


**Our statement**



We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people with diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate based upon age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

  



If you require any accommodations or have any accessibility needs, please reach out via email \[email protected] or make a member of our Talent Acquisition team aware at any time.

  



If you’re ready to bring your skills, curiosity, and passion, click **Apply** and let’s explore what we can achieve together!

title: Assistant Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
**What is the mission of the Recruiting team at Pocket FM?** 




  





 We are who we are because of our people. The mission of this team is to always ensure we hire better than 80% of the people currently performing in their roles.
 



  





 Recruiting is step 1 towards building and maintaining an organization. Your role is sacred. You are the gatekeeper of the culture. Shaping the public perception of what we represent. Giving people a reason to join. Making working with Pocket FM irresistible.
 



  





 Our kind of recruiting is a mix of HR and sales, with a strong shot of marketing. Recruiters must simultaneously attract the right audience, size up a candidate, and sell them on the company. Pocket FM is only as good as its talent.
 



 It is about doing certain things right every single day. Brilliance comes from doing the basics right.
 



  





**What is the breadth and depth you will have to go to aid this?** 




  





 As a recruiter, you are expected to be a strong filter and make a decision after your conversations. For this, there is a need to learn how to articulate your ‘gut feeling’ and provide a ‘yes’ or ‘no’ answer.
 



  




* Source smarter, not louder. Sourcing is a very critical aspect of your role. Scouting passive talent from the industry and using out\-of\-the\-box sources through marketing and networking would help you meet your deliverables within the deadline. Daily, you need to identify great talent from a combination of sources and get them through the door
* Driving successful referral campaigns; our people are the best sources
 *(yes, there are many different ways of driving referral programs)* 
 . Enabling the business to generate more referrals is a very critical aspect of your role
* Be a pipeline Ninja. Maintaining a constant pipeline
 *(\~3x of targets),* 
 which ensures a solid talent pool from which we can meet our hiring requirements
* Hiring priorities shift fast. Agility and business fluency are must\-haves. Lead through change
* Protect the candidate experience. How we treat candidates reflects how we operate as a business
* You must go beyond requisitions. Understanding the why behind a hire is just as critical as the how. Influence business outcomes
* Zero tolerance for mediocrity. You raise the bar. You understand the silent cost of “adequate” hires and never settle. Because you know that one wrong hire can bring down the energy, efficiency, and performance of an entire team



  





  





**What do you need to bring to the table to perform well?** 




  




* Are you a good storyteller?
* What kind of mindset do you have? Do you think you have a learning mindset?
* Be courteous, be conversational, be rigorous, and be realistic
* Being on the same page with your stakeholders is the base starting point of your success
* Predicting the success of the candidate is your success here; hope is not a strategy
* You need to be well\-versed in the products. You cannot be on the back foot in your conversations

description:
**Data Analyst**

**Location:** Kolkata  
**Department:** Research \& Analytics  
**Experience:** Fresher or up to 1 Year

**About the Organisation**

The WE Foundation (TWF) is a registered non\-profit organisation dedicated to building resilient communities and sustainable families through innovative, community\-owned development models. Established in 2011 and operating at scale since 2019, TWF works across key areas including education, health, WASH (Water, Sanitation and Hygiene), women’s health and hygiene, poverty alleviation, and climate resilience. Driven by the belief that lasting change begins at the grassroots, we collaborate with communities, governments, corporates, and development partners to create sustainable solutions that improve lives and strengthen local ecosystems.

**Role Overview**

The WE Foundation is looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Data Analyst**, who is responsible for transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support strategic planning, program implementation, and organizational decision\-making. The role involves collecting, cleaning, validating, analysing, and interpreting data from multiple sources to identify trends, measure performance, and generate actionable recommendations. The Data Analyst will use statistical and analytical tools such as **SPSS** and **STATA**, along with advanced Excel and data visualization platforms, to prepare reports, dashboards, and presentations for internal teams and external stakeholders. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical, statistical, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to communicate complex findings in a clear and concise manner while ensuring data accuracy, quality, and confidentiality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Analysis \& Statistical Modelling**

· Conduct quantitative and qualitative data analysis using **SPSS, STATA**, and other statistical software.

· Perform descriptive and inferential statistical analyses, including regression, hypothesis testing, correlation, and trend analysis.

· Interpret complex datasets to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights that support organizational goals.

**Data Collection \& Management**

· Collect, compile, clean, validate, and manage data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

· Design and maintain databases, datasets, and data management systems for efficient storage and retrieval.

· Ensure data quality through regular verification, validation, and quality assurance processes.

**Reporting \& Data Visualization**

· Prepare analytical reports, dashboards, scorecards, and presentations for management, clients, and stakeholders.

· Present findings in a clear, concise, and visually appealing manner using charts, graphs, and data visualization tools.

· Generate periodic and ad hoc reports to support project monitoring, evaluation, and decision\-making.

**Monitoring, Evaluation \& Research Support**

· Support monitoring and evaluation (M\&E) activities by analysing program and project data.

· Assist in designing survey questionnaires, data collection tools, and sampling methodologies.

· Conduct data validation, statistical testing, and impact assessments for research and evaluation studies.

**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Support**

· Work closely with program teams, researchers, and management to understand data requirements and provide analytical support.

· Translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

· Provide technical guidance on data collection, analysis methodologies, and statistical techniques.

**Qualifications**

· Bachelor's degree in **Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Social Sciences, Public Health, or a related quantitative field.**

· Freshers or candidates with up to 1 **year of experience** in data analysis, statistical research, monitoring \& evaluation (M\&E), business intelligence, or a similar analytical role**.**

**Required Skills**

· Proficiency in **SPSS** and **STATA** for data management, statistical analysis, and interpretation.

· Strong knowledge of **descriptive and inferential statistics**, including regression analysis, hypothesis testing, correlation, ANOVA, and predictive modelling.

· Advanced proficiency in **Microsoft Excel**, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, advanced formulas, charts, and data analysis tools.

· Experience with **SQL** for data extraction, querying, and database management.

· Familiarity with **Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools** for creating interactive dashboards and reports.

· Working knowledge of **R\* or** Python\* for statistical analysis, data automation, and predictive analytics is an added advantage.

· Knowledge of **research methodologies, survey design, sampling techniques, and Monitoring \& Evaluation (M\&E) frameworks**.

**What We Offer**

· Opportunity to contribute to impactful, data\-driven projects that support organizational growth and informed decision\-making.

· A collaborative, inclusive, and purpose\-driven work environment that values innovation and analytical thinking.

· Involvement in research, monitoring \& evaluation (M\&E), and evidence\-based program planning and reporting.

· Opportunities to enhance skills in business intelligence, data visualization, predictive analytics, and data management.

description:
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Graduate Mechanical Engineer to join our team for the establishment and operation of our new Turmeric Processing Plant in Nanded. This role provides an excellent opportunity for fresh engineering graduates to gain hands\-on industrial experience in plant engineering, equipment installation, preventive maintenance, and continuous process improvement.

Key ResponsibilitiesPlant Establishment

* Assist in the installation and commissioning of turmeric processing machinery and equipment.

Documentation

* Prepare daily engineering activity reports.
* Maintain equipment manuals, drawings, warranty records, and maintenance logs.
* Update preventive maintenance checklists and inspection records.
* Assist in preparing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and work instructions.

Continuous Improvement

* Identify opportunities to improve machine efficiency and reduce downtime.
* Suggest modifications to improve productivity and equipment reliability.
* Participate in cost\-saving and energy\-efficiency initiatives.

Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech. or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

Preferred Knowledge

Basic understanding of:

* Mechanical equipment and machine components
* Pumps, bearings, gearboxes, and motors
* Preventive and breakdown maintenance
* Engineering drawings and AutoCAD
* Industrial safety practices
* Production and maintenance planning

* Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
