title: Member of Technical Staff - Research
description:
**About the Role:** 




  





 Robotics is an industry that has been gestating for 70 years yet it has never arrived.
 



  





 Every time, its perceived moment arrived, it was always an "Use\-Case" for some other technology, including now \- an Use\-Case for \#LLM/VLA. Intelligence is a Slave of Data\-\> Slave of Signal \-\> Slave of Sensor. Not Action. Robotics is Formfactor and action obsessed, but autonomy begins from Sensing.
 



  





 Robotics is often mistaken for a problem that's just lacks Savvy Engineering to put together current technology in a meaningful way. In reality \- Robotics lacks \& needs foundational and fundamental technology \& tools needed to Build it. This is a Foundational research problem.
 



  





 Robotics has a problem of Building a Car with Cycle Wheels. None of the technology or the components that we use for robotics were developed for Robotic Manipulation.
 



  





 Beyond the dancing mannequins, Robotics is a Foundational \#Research problem, and it begins from Sensing by Action to Force Controlled Motion than just Position Control to Multi\-Arm Action Planning to Foundations of \#ML that Mirrors \#Neuroscience of Cognition \& Motion.
 



  





 𝐑𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐁𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧! 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐨𝐧𝐞.
 



  





 If you are a researcher, a PHD student, Post doc or a Research scientist/ Faculty and if you connect with the Constraints of Current Approach to Intelligence, Sensors, Compute and Robotics and is eager to dive deep into the Rabit hole \- Apply.
 



  





 https://lnkd.in/gDCNtJnw
 



  





  





**Research Topics \& Domains:** 




  





***Vision and Algorithms***



* Dynamic Vision \- Vergence, Motion Imaging \& Dynamic depth – Hierarchical Depth Construction, Imaging, Optics \& sensors – Building intelligence into Sensing
* Exploring primitive Neural layers/ Pathway of Human vision
* Object Composition – Texture, contours, grasp mapping, force field – process of learning an object \- Primitive Visual Patterns and stitching of contours into an object
* Process of Colour Construction
* Understanding Reflections, Attention \& Priority of Feature Selection
* Visual Models \- breaking down scenes into Action models
* Involuntary \& Voluntary Imaging



  





***Manipulation \& Sensing***




  




* Skin Transducers for Touch – RF, Capacitive, etc \- Modular Tactile Design for the shape and format of Fingers \& Arms
* Convergent Camera Design \& Image sensor design , Autofocus Liquid Lens Optics Design
* Neuromorphic Image Sensor pipeline \- FPGA
* Sensing Primitives\- Creating Sensor Physics in Simulation Environment to map Sensor’s signal response for different object interactions
* Alternate Modes of Actuation for Robots \& Motion Control – Tendon, Tendon \+ Joint Actuation
* Motor \& motion Design for Wrist and Ball joints



  





**Machine Learning** 



* Neuromorphic NN designs \- Neural morphology \- Breaking down neural patterns and their Functions
* MPC \& RL Design
* On\-the\- Fly Learning process \& Live weight modelling
* Signals to senses, closed loop architectures in Neurons
* Adaptive Learning Architectures – Dynamic Weights, Static \& dynamic neural patterns
* Neural memory \& temporal neurons
* Dimensionality of physical actions encoding into neural pathways
* Auto Object learning Setup for Robots



  





**Robot Control** 



* Multi arm Kinematics Multi Arm\- task Scheduling and Task sequencing
* Grasp Models And Force Modelled Grasping Algorithm Library for
* Gripper Design \& Construction
* Multi\-Finger Trajectory \& Grasp Planning
* Action primitives – Action models
* Data (Signal) Model of Objects
* Dynamic Collision planning
* Energy Optimized path Planning and motion breakdown between Arms Force\- Primacy Control
* Breaking down tasks into Micro Actions and Building Micro RL models for Grasp, Task



  





**Requirements:** 




  





**What do you need to thrive in this Job?** 



1. **Business empathy** 
 \- Most important mistake that Engineers and Researchers make is Not including the constraints of business as a factor of the problem we solve. From Money, volatility of customer interest, Runway, resource availability, Supply chain bottlenecks, Manufacturability, Scalability, Serviceability, Team Alignment, tool, Skill \& infra bottlenecks – all of these dictate the relevance of what one builds more than the principles and tech. A research that doesn’t track its relevance to these metrics most often ends up unviable. Miss one, the whole approach goes unusable or unviable.
2. **Outcome oriented Research** 
 – Key factor that differentiates Academic research from Industrial Research. Have developed structured methods to accelerate open ended problems
3. **Customer/User focus** 
 – This is the north star and gives purpose. The greatest joy is in seeing someone benefit from your work. Even greater joy is in they getting addicted to your work. Not Paper focused.
4. **Discipline \& Consistency** 
 \- Research is an unobjective business and its easy to hide behind its subjectivity and justify delay/ mood swings. When system lacks objectivity, Its self\-discipline that gets you to the goal. Timelines Matter – Simply because money runs out. Easiest hack – Learn to carve out usable outcomes our of every step of progress in Research, even if the entire research is yet to materialize.
5. As part of the Job you will be responsible for
 **joint research efforts with Research institutions** 
 including IISC \& EPFL. You will be responsible to coordinate the research activities between CynLr \& the Partner Research Institutions. And manage outcomes out of the engagements.



  





**Who should Apply?** 



* If you are a Post\-Docs, Phds, Research faculties, Research scientist looking to further your research into materialized real\-world outcomes
* You are in your UG/PG, but beyond the romance of research \& titles, if you have understood the grind of research and is keen on building technology that needs solving a foundational problem for customers/industry that requires research, please apply.
* Driven Not by Papers, Not Patents, Not titles – just utility, Please apply. Understand the difference between experimental research and paper research.
* If you have realized the limitations of current approach to Intelligence and Robotics technologies and recognize the need for deeper research.
* Structured research mindset – Not Jugaad.



  





**Technical Skill :** 



* Very strong fundamentals understanding in respective subjects.
* For
 **Algo \& Compute** 
 – HPC/GPU role, you need to have exceptional understanding of Computer Architecture, Compliers \& OS.
* For
 **Computational Neuroscience \& Vision** 
 \- Proficient with Computer Vision, Physics of Light \& Optics, Fundamentals of Neurons/Neuroscience.
* For
 **Optics, Sensors \& HW** 
 \- Proficient with Electronic Design, Materials, Optics, Signals \& Systems. Savy with instrumentation.
* For
 **Robotics \& Motion Contro** 
 l – Strong with Controls Theory, MPC \& Adaptive control, working experience with Motion Control Design, Proficiency in Robot Control \& Kinematics, Machine learning Fundamentals.
* For
 **ML/RL research** 
 – Proficient with ML Architecture design, Temporal NN design, Designing Reinforcement Learning , Foundations of NN and neuron design, Learning Design.
* **Fundamentals of Systems and Control theory**
* Strong
 **penchant for Instrumentation** 
 (designing measurement tools/methods \& sensors), analytics and designing experiments
* Proficiency with programming– You don’t have to be tool/Language experts.



  





**What This Role is NOT** 



* Pure academic paper driven research.



  





**Team Structure** 




 The Technical Program Manager operates within the Founder’s Office, embedded directly into the engineering organization.
 



 While the TPM works closely with the founder(s), the role interfaces continuously with:
 



 • Engineering leads
 



 • HR and Talent, for performance programs and people\-related interventions
 



 • Finance and Operations, for resource planning and project budgeting
 



 • External vendors and tooling partners, where applicable
 



 The TPM owns process design and delivery hygiene across all engineering streams — acting as the connective layer that keeps multi\-disciplinary teams aligned without creating dependency on a single coordination point.
 



  





**About CynLr** 




  





 As a foundational technology building company in Robotics \& AI,
 
 CynLr
 
 builds visual robots \- Cynoid \& CyRo that
 
 can intuitively learn to pick \& handle even unknown objects without requiring any prior training
 
 , just like a human baby fiddles with objects. CynLr calls this stack as Object Intelligence (OI).
 



  





 From fitting a screw to removing object out of its the plastic wrapper to automating the assembly of a car/gadget \- every such object handling task that involves "adapting on the fly" is not prior trainable \& thereby remains non\-automatable across the industries. CynLr builds a stack of Micro RL blocks called Sensing \& Action Primitives, using which a High Level Task can be composed.
 



  





 With OI's ability to learn on the fly, CynLr’s focus is to universally automate factories and eliminate the need for complicated custom machines to manufacture products. Thereby simplifying manufacturing into
 
 Universal Factories
 
 , which can be programmatically repurposed to produce wide varieties of Products.
 



  





 CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
 *deeply inspired by neuroscience,* 
 modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



  





 We are a deep\-tech robotics company at the intersection of computer vision, real\-time control systems, and precision hardware, headquartered in Bengaluru with a Swiss entity. Our engineering spans optics, embedded systems, firmware, real\-time software, mechanical design, and applied research.

title: Lead System Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to drive the design, integration, and deployment of semi\-autonomous and autonomous systems. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role that sits at the intersection of software and hardware: you will take complex components AI engines, control systems, sensors, and actuators and integrate them into robust, production\-ready systems that perform reliably in the real world.
   

  

 Beyond engineering, you will lead and mentor a team of engineers and coordinate across functions to ensure products are delivered on time and to spec. The ideal candidate combines strong coding fundamentals, deep systems intuition, and the ability to keep multiple workstreams moving toward a shared goal.
   

  

**Systems Architecture And Integration**
 The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions
 **:**
* Architect and integrate diverse software and hardware components into cohesive, well\-functioning semi\-autonomous and autonomous systems.
* Define interfaces, data flows, and integration standards across subsystems to ensure seamless interoperability.
* Make pragmatic trade\-offs between performance, reliability, cost, and time\-to\-market across the full system stack.


**Software Development**
* Design, develop, and maintain software in C\+\+ and Python across critical subsystems, including AI/perception engines, control systems, and sensor\-actuator integration layers.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code, with attention to real\-time performance and resource constraints.
* Contribute to and uphold engineering best practices around code review, version control, and documentation.


**Debugging And Root\-Cause Analysis**
* Investigate complex, cross\-system issues spanning software, hardware, and their interactions.
* Conduct systematic root\-cause analysis to identify the true source of failures rather than surface symptoms.
* Develop efficient, durable resolutions and put safeguards in place to prevent recurrence.


**Technical Leadership And Cross\-Team Coordination**
* Lead, mentor, and guide a team of engineers, setting technical direction and raising the bar on quality.
* Coordinate across teams software, hardware, AI, QA, and product to align priorities and remove blockers.
* Own delivery milestones, track progress against schedules, and ensure the team ships reliable products on time.


**Edge Deployment**
* Deploy and optimise systems on edge devices, accounting for constraints in compute, memory, power, and connectivity.
* Anticipate and resolve deployment\-related challenges such as hardware variability, over\-the\-air updates, latency, and field reliability.
* Tune software for efficient on\-device execution without compromising functionality or safety.


**Test Strategy And Validation**
* Define and implement comprehensive testing strategies to validate and harden the system end\-to\-end.
* Build test coverage across unit, integration, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, and system\-level scenarios, including edge cases and failure modes.
* Establish validation processes that ensure robustness, safety, and consistent performance before deployment.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering field (e. g., Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, or related discipline).
* 2\-4 years of professional experience in systems engineering, ideally involving the integration of software and hardware.
* Strong programming skills in C\+\+ and Python.
* Demonstrated experience developing or integrating components such as AI engines, control systems, and sensor\-actuator interfaces.
* Proven debugging and root\-cause analysis skills across complex, multi\-component systems.
* Experience working with edge devices and an understanding of real\-world deployment challenges.
* Ability to design and execute thorough testing and validation strategies.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead a team and coordinate across functions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in a relevant engineering field.
* Direct experience building semi\-autonomous or autonomous systems (e. g., robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles, industrial automation).
* Familiarity with real\-time operating systems, embedded development, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring engineering teams.
* Exposure to safety\-critical or production\-grade system development.

title: Lead Design Engineer
description:
**Job Description** 




 Lead Design Engineer – Actuator Manufacturing
 



 Location: Vapi
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly experienced
 **Lead Design Engineer** 
 to lead the design and manufacturing development of precision actuators for robotic systems. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in gearbox design, transmission systems, gear calculations, and manufacturing process planning, with the ability to translate heavy\-duty gearbox knowledge into compact, high\-precision robotic actuator systems.
 



  





 This role will focus on developing high\-torque\-density, lightweight, and precision transmission systems used in robotic joints such as hip, knee, shoulder, and elbow assemblies.
 



  





 Why Gearbox Experience is Critical for Robotics Actuators?
 



  





 Your gearbox experience directly contributes to:
 


* Planetary gear reduction system design
* Shaft and bearing life calculations
* Gear rating and safety validation (AGMA / ISO standards)
* Manufacturing stage drawing \& process planning
* Precision assembly support



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Actuator Transmission Design** 



* Lead design of precision planetary and harmonic\-like gear reduction systems for robotic actuators.
* Develop compact, lightweight transmission systems for humanoid robot joints.
* Perform torque density optimization and reduction ratio selection.
* Design shafts, gears, bearings, and housing for high accuracy applications.



**2\. Engineering Calculations \& Validation** 



* Perform:
* Gear rating calculations
* Shaft safety analysis
* Bearing life estimation
* Torsional stiffness analysis
* Use KISSsoft / KISSsys for gear system validation.
* Optimize backlash and precision performance.
* Ensure compliance with ISO / AGMA standards.



**3\. Manufacturing Development** 



* Develop gear manufacturing process plans for precision gears.
* Design jigs \& fixtures for actuator assembly.
* Support precision machining and heat treatment processes.
* Ensure tolerance stack\-up analysis for high\-accuracy systems.



**4\. Prototype \& Testing Support** 



* Support actuator prototype builds.
* Work closely with motor integration team.
* Troubleshoot assembly and performance issues.
* Improve efficiency, noise reduction, and vibration control.



**5\. PLM, Documentation \& Systems** 



* Create GA, sectional, and detailed manufacturing drawings.
* Manage BOM using PLM/PDM systems (Teamcenter / Windchill / EPDM).
* Coordinate ERP integration with SAP / Oracle.



**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Collaborate with:
* Motor design team
* Electronics team
* Control systems team
* Manufacturing team
* Guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Lead design reviews and technical validation sessions.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* B.E. Mechanical Engineering
* 10\+ years experience in gearbox / transmission design
* Strong knowledge of:
* Planetary gear systems
* Shaft \& bearing calculations
* Gear manufacturing processes
* Material selection for high\-performance gears
* Experience with 3D CAD (NX / Creo / SolidWorks)
* Hands\-on experience with KISSsoft / KISSsys



  





**Preferred (Robotics Advantage)** 



* Experience in compact gearbox design
* Exposure to servo motor integration
* Knowledge of backlash reduction techniques
* Understanding of precision assembly \& tolerance stack\-up
* Experience in lightweight material design



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to translate heavy\-duty gearbox principles into precision robotic actuators
* Leadership and cross\-functional coordination
* Strong design validation and manufacturing support capability

title: Scrum Master
description:
Position Description
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master with 6–10 years of experience to lead Agile teams and ensure the successful delivery of software development projects. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in facilitating Scrum ceremonies, coaching teams on Agile methodologies, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role requires close collaboration with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Development, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders to deliver high\-quality software solutions while maintaining Agile best practices.

 Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Sprint Retrospectives.

 Coordinate with Business Analysts, Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth sprint execution.
   

  

 Track sprint progress, team velocity, burn\-down charts, and other Agile metrics to monitor delivery performance.
   

  

 Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks, dependencies, and blockers.
   

  

 Maintain Agile project dashboards, sprint reports, and documentation using Jira and Confluence.
   

  

 Support release planning, sprint forecasting, and capacity planning activities.
   

  

 Drive continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance team efficiency and delivery quality.
   

  

 Facilitate effective communication between cross\-functional teams and leadership.
   

  

 Promote Agile best practices and support Agile transformation initiatives across the organization.
   

  

 Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality software while maintaining transparency and stakeholder alignment.
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
   

  

 6–10 years of experience in Agile project delivery with at least 3\+ years as a Scrum Master.
   

  

 Strong understanding of Agile principles, Scrum framework, SDLC, and software development practices.
   

  

 Experience managing multiple Agile teams and coordinating cross\-functional initiatives.
   

  

 Excellent communication, leadership, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

description:

**RoboMQ** 
 is a fast\-growing SaaS company delivering disruptive Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions to mid\-market enterprise customers. Our flagship product,
 **Hire2Retire**
 , automates the employee identity lifecycle by integrating HR systems with Identity Management and other applications helping organizations achieve seamless onboarding, offboarding, compliance, and security with zero\-trust and least\-privilege security posture.
 



  





 Hire2Retire is featured in
 **Gartner** 
 Market Guides and has been a consistent high performer on
 **G2** 
 in user provisioning and IAM tools.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 This role is focused on creating and maintaining clear, accurate documentation and technical content for RoboMQ’s products, with a primary focus on Hire2Retire. You will work closely with product managers and engineers to understand how features work in real customer environments and document them in a way that is practical and easy to use.
 



 In addition to product documentation, you will contribute to whitepapers and solution\-focused content like marketplace listings and product demo scripts. Much of our product docs content is maintained in GitHub, so comfort with version\-controlled documentation is important.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Responsible For** 




 Product \& Documentation Work
 


* Write and maintain Hire2Retire documentation, including user guides, feature explanations, and configuration steps
* Document end\-to\-end product workflows
* Keep documentation aligned with product releases and changes by working closely with engineering and product teams
* Review existing content and improve clarity, structure, and accuracy where needed



 Whitepapers \& Solution Content
 


* Contribute to whitepapers, technical explainers, and solution briefs
* Present technical concepts using a clear problem–solution approach that connects technology to business impact



 GitHub \& Collaboration
 



 Create and update documentation stored in GitHub repositories using Markdown
 



 Content Quality \& Consistency
 


* Maintain consistency in terminology, tone, and structure across all documentation
* Ensure content is accurate, actionable, and easy to follow for both technical and semi\-technical users
* Identify gaps, outdated content, or unclear sections and propose improvements



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 3\+ years of experience as a Technical Writer in a SaaS, enterprise software, or B2B technology environment.
 



 Proven experience writing:
 


* Product documentation, demo video scripts and user guides
* Technical or solution\-focused long\-form content (whitepapers, explainers)
* Ability to understand technical systems such as APIs, integrations, and workflows, and document them clearly
* Hands\-on experience working with GitHub for documentation (Markdown, pull requests, version history)
* Strong written communication skills and attention to detail
* Comfortable working directly with product and engineering teams



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Familiarity with identity management, identity governance, or access management concepts
* Experience documenting integrations involving HR systems, directories (Active Directory / Entra), or SaaS applications
* Exposure to release documentation or change logs



  





**Why Join RoboMQ** 



* Work on a product that solves real operational and security challenges for enterprises.
* High\-impact role with ownership over core product documentation and technical content.
* Direct collaboration with product and engineering teams.
* Opportunity to influence how customers understand and use Hire2Retire.

 **ScaleFlux** 
 Bangalore, Karnataka, India
 



  





 At ScaleFlux, we are a family unit powered by diversity, inclusion, transparency, respect, integrity, and passion—for both our clients and our people. Our business growth depends on your professional development, as we collaborate, share ideas and innovations, and invest in our future. By forging meaningful partnerships with our people, we come together with a shared purpose, exceeding our goals. This keeps us nimble, ahead of the competition, and at the forefront of our industry. title: R&D Member of Technical Staff - II, Technical Writing
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:** 
 R\&D Member of Technical Staff \- II, Technical Writing
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India – Hybrid
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time regular (flexible working options available
   

  

**The job**
 As part of our global technical writing group, you’ll collaborate with one or more teams of skilled software engineers from our global research \& development group in writing and publishing technical documentation and associated content for our products and solutions. You’ll help us research and transform complex technical concepts, specifications, and procedures into user\-oriented information for non\-technical and technical audiences for developing high\-quality software documentation that meets user needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Learn complex work from self\-learning, training, and shadowing seniors
* Work under minimal supervision on advanced, unstructured, and complex work
* Improve the quality of content, adhere to the established standards and guidelines, and deliver on time
* Design, develop, review, and publish high\-quality technical documentation


**Essential Requirements**
* Experience in working with products and solutions in industrial software
* Experience in working with global agile and DevOps teams
* Experience in working with Author\-it Cloud and Microsoft Azure


**Desired Skills And Competencies**
* Master’s or bachelor's degree in English, Computer Science, or Engineering
* 3\-5 years of experience in technical writing and documentation development
* Knowledge of software product development and cloud computing services
* Competent at concepts, processes, and tools of technical writing and information development
* Competent in using productivity tools from Microsoft and content management tools from Adobe
* Competent at DITA, structured authoring, and component content management systems
* Competent in using tools for screen capturing and recording and audio and video editing


**R\&D at AVEVA**
 Our global team of 2000\+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
   

  

 Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r\-and\-d\-careers/
   

  

**India Benefits include:**
 Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support
   

  

 It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
   

  

**Hybrid working**
 We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
   

  

**Hiring process**
 Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process

 AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
   

  

 We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/

title: Content Writer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Emphere is an AI\-driven technology company focused on automated remediation for containers. The organization helps development and operations teams identify, fix, and prevent issues across the software lifecycle, improving reliability and security. By leveraging advanced machine learning, Emphere delivers intelligent solutions that streamline workflows and reduce manual intervention. The company offers a fast\-paced, innovation\-focused environment for professionals who want to work at the intersection of AI and modern infrastructure.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, remote Content Writer role based anywhere in India. The Content Writer will create clear, engaging, and technically accurate content that explains Emphere’s AI remediation solutions for containers. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include researching industry trends, collaborating with product and engineering teams to translate complex concepts into accessible narratives, and producing web pages, blog posts, case studies, and marketing collateral. The role also involves maintaining a consistent brand voice, optimizing content for readability and discoverability, and proofreading and editing materials to ensure quality and accuracy. The Content Writer will contribute to content planning and strategy to support product launches, customer education, and overall brand awareness.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Web Content Writing and Writing skills to produce clear, concise, and engaging digital content.
* Experience with Content Strategy, including planning, organizing, and optimizing content across channels.
* Proficiency in Research to gather information from technical sources, industry publications, and internal subject matter experts.
* Excellent Proofreading skills with attention to detail, grammar, and style consistency.
* Relevant experience writing about technology, software development, cloud infrastructure, or AI solutions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, English, Technical Writing, Journalism, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Engineering Services Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Engineering Services Practitioner
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Assist with end\-to\-end engineering services to develop technical engineering solutions to solve problems and achieve business objectives. Solve engineering problems and achieve business objectives using scientific, socio\-economic, technical knowledge and practical experience. Work across structural and stress design, qualification, configuration and technical management.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Aircraft Maintenance Manual Authoring Guidelines
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 0\-2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As an Engineering Services Practitioner, a typical day involves supporting the delivery of comprehensive engineering services by contributing to the development of technical solutions that address complex challenges. The role requires collaboration across various engineering disciplines, including structural and stress design, qualification, configuration, and technical management. Throughout the day, the practitioner assists in problem\-solving activities, applying a blend of scientific, socio\-economic, and technical knowledge alongside practical experience to meet business goals. This position demands active engagement in multidisciplinary teamwork to ensure the successful execution of engineering projects and the achievement of organizational objectives.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to build knowledge and support the team.
* Participate in Problem Solving discussions.
* Assist in documenting and maintaining engineering processes to ensure clarity and consistency.
* Collaborate with team members to gather and analyze data relevant to engineering challenges.
* Support junior team members by sharing insights and facilitating knowledge transfer.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Aircraft Maintenance Manual Authoring Guidelines.
* Strong understanding of technical documentation standards and practices related to aircraft maintenance.
* Ability to interpret and apply engineering principles within the context of maintenance manual authoring.
* Familiarity with regulatory requirements and compliance standards in the aerospace industry.
* Effective communication skills to clearly convey technical information in written form.
* Attention to detail to ensure accuracy and completeness of maintenance manuals.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 0\-2 years of experience in Aircraft Maintenance Manual Authoring Guidelines.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
description:
**About Marklytics** 




  





 Marklytics builds enterprise data platforms for manufacturers and industrial groups. Our software collects operational data from complex, multi\-party supply chains, verifies it, and turns it into the records our customers are required to produce for their auditors, customers and regulators.
 



 We work with large industrial businesses across Europe and Asia through our teams in the United Kingdom and India.
 



  





 This requirement shapes the way we engineer our products. Data must be traceable back to its source, numbers must reconcile, and every output must survive external scrutiny months after it was generated. When our platform is wrong, our customers do not simply have a user\-experience problem they have a compliance problem.
 



  





 Our engineering team is intentionally small. Engineers own systems rather than tickets, communicate directly with the people who use what they build, and are trusted to make architectural decisions. There is no separate team waiting to fix your code once it reaches production.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 This is an early career engineering role for someone who writes application code and takes quality seriously inequal measure. You will split your time between building features and building the automated test coverage that keeps them working, with close support from senior engineers.
 



  





 This is a development role, not a QA seat. You will ship real product code from your first month. The reason testing sits in the job at all is that our customers use our output as evidence, so a regression that reaches production is not a cosmetic problem for them. If you want to become a strong full stack engineer and you understand that testing is part of engineering rather than something handed to somebody else, this is a good seat.
 



  





 In practice the week is built around leaving you alone to work. A short standup each morning, a product and engineering demo every two weeks, and otherwise uninterrupted time to build.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Build front end components and screens in React or Next.js with TypeScript that customers use to enter, review and correct their data.
* Implement API endpoints and back end logic in Node.js or Python, with guidance and review from senior engineers.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests using Jest, Vitest, PyTest or equivalent frameworks.
* Build and maintain end\-to\-end test suites in Playwright or Cypress, keeping them fast and free of flakiness, because a flaky suite is one everybody learns to ignore.
* Carry out API testing using Postman or automated equivalents.
* Write clear, reproducible defect reports, and verify fixes properly before closing them.
* Support regression testing ahead of releases, and help move work out of manual checking and into automation.
* Take part in code review, both giving and receiving feedback.



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  




* You have one to two years of professional software development experience. Substantial internship work counts.
* You are comfortable with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, and you have written some back end code in Node.js or Python.
* You understand SQL and relational database fundamentals.
* You have used at least one automated testing framework on real work, not only in a tutorial.
* You understand why unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests exist separately and what each one is good at.
* You investigate before you escalate. When something breaks, your instinct is to find out why rather than to pass it on.
* You can take direct feedback on your code without taking it personally.



  





**Bonus points** 




  




* CI pipelines that run tests automatically on every change.
* Contract testing, test data management or performance testing.
* Any cloud platform exposure, on AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Any hands\-on work with LLM APIs, even from side projects.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**About the Organisation** 




 Loch Corporate Services is a professional services firm delivering a broad range of solutions across administrative, technical, marketing, and specialised operational areas. Established with a focus on high quality and compliant service delivery.Loch supports organisations seeking integrated support functions under a single trusted provider. The firm is committed to strict confidentiality standards, consistent quality controls and seamless collaboration with client teams across multiple sectors.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Full Stack Engineer will design, build, and maintain web applications across the front end and back end as part of a small, fast\-moving development team. This role requires strong technical breadth across modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, backend services, and relational databases, with a focus on shipping reliable, well\-documented software. The Full Stack Engineer will take ownership of features from initial design through to deployment and ongoing support, working closely with the Lead Developer and cross\-functional partners in design and product.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, and maintain web applications using React/Next.js on the front end and Node.js, or an equivalent, on the back end
* Design and build REST APIs, and integrate with third\-party services and internal systems
* Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including query writing, schema design, and performance considerations
* Contribute to internal tools and automation that improve the team's day\-to\-day efficiency
* Write clean, readable, and well\-documented code that can be maintained by others
* Debug issues across the full stack, from front\-end defects to slow queries and flaky API calls
* Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and broader technical discussions
* Support the deployment and monitoring of applications, including basic cloud and DevOps tasks such as CI/CD pipelines and containerisation
* Collaborate with design, product, and other cross\-functional teams to translate requirements into working software



  





**Key Deliverables** 



* Web applications and features delivered on time, to specification, and to the required quality standard
* Clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code contributed to the codebase
* Issues and defects identified, debugged, and resolved across the stack
* Active, constructive participation in code reviews, sprint planning, and deployment activities



  





**Required Skills and Attributes** 



* One to three years of hands\-on experience building web applications, whether through professional work or internships with real shipped work
* Solid grasp of JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern front\-end framework such as React or Next.js
* Experience building or consuming REST APIs and a working understanding of front\-end/back\-end integration
* Familiarity with relational databases and a working knowledge of SQL
* Comfortable with Git and everyday version control workflows
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, or to containerisation with Docker, is an advantage
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work well within a small, collaborative team
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools and technologies as the role requires



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience



  





**Employee Benefits** 



* Health insurance coverage
* Paid annual leave
* Performance\-linked bonus subject to eligibility and company policy



  





**Compliance and Confidentiality** 




 The Full Stack Engineer is required to operate exclusively within approved systems and platforms as directed by Loch. All client and organisational data must be handled in strict accordance with the firm's data handling protocols. Any client\-facing outputs must be subject to appropriate review and oversight prior to delivery. The role holder must maintain confidentiality of all client, commercial, and operational information at all times.

We are seeking a highly organised and detail\-oriented Publishing Operations Executive to support the end\-to\-end publication and distribution of books across multiple domains including child development, psychology, education, human potential, storytelling, productivity, leadership, and personal growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys transforming ideas into finished books through structured coordination, documentation, editorial support, vendor management, and publishing operations.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Founder and publishing team to ensure that manuscripts move efficiently from concept to publication and distribution while maintaining high standards of quality and consistency.

Editorial \& Manuscript Coordination

* Organise and maintain manuscript versions and publishing records
* Coordinate the movement of manuscripts through drafting, editing, proofreading, typesetting, and publication stages
* Assist in converting transcripts, recordings, and source materials into structured manuscript drafts
* Coordinate with editors, proofreaders, translators, and content contributors
* Ensure timely completion of editorial milestones

Publishing Operations

* Coordinate ISBN procurement and publication metadata management
* Liaise with DOI registration agencies and publishing service providers
* Maintain publication records and documentation
* Assist in preparing copyright, front matter, acknowledgements, references, and publication information pages
* Ensure compliance with publishing requirements and standards

Production Management

* Coordinate with cover designers, illustrators, typesetters, and layout professionals
* Review production deliverables against project specifications
* Track revisions and ensure implementation of feedback
* Manage production schedules and deadlines

Print \& Distribution Coordination

* Coordinate print runs and print\-on\-demand activities
* Communicate with printers and distribution partners
* Manage book inventory records where applicable
* Coordinate logistics related to book dispatch and fulfilment
* Track publication and distribution status

Vendor Coordination

* Serve as the primary point of contact for publishing\-related vendors
* Obtain quotations and compare service providers when required
* Follow up with designers, printers, typesetters, editors, and other external partners
* Ensure vendor deliverables are completed on time and meet expected quality standards

Research \& Administrative Support

* Conduct publishing\-related research as required
* Gather information regarding publication platforms, distribution channels, academic indexing, metadata requirements, and industry best practices
* Prepare summaries, comparison sheets, and recommendations for decision\-making
* Assist in maintaining publishing workflows and operational systems

Documentation \& Project Tracking

* Maintain structured project trackers for all ongoing publications
* Monitor deadlines, dependencies, and pending actions
* Prepare periodic status reports for leadership review
* Organise digital assets, manuscripts, covers, marketing materials, and publication records in a systematic manner

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in English, Publishing, Journalism, Communications, Humanities, Business Administration, or related fields
* Prior experience in a publishing house, academic publishing company, editorial services organisation, content production company, or similar environment
* Strong understanding of publishing workflows and production cycles
* Excellent documentation and organisational skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Candidates with prior exposure to any of the following will be preferred:

* Book publishing operations
* Academic publishing
* Editorial coordination
* Journal management
* Metadata management
* ISBN workflows
* DOI workflows
* Typesetting and production coordination
* Amazon KDP or print\-on\-demand publishing platforms
* Working with digital productivity and workflow management tools

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* Takes ownership and follows through until tasks are completed
* Is highly organised and dependable
* Enjoys working behind the scenes to make complex projects move smoothly
* Is comfortable learning and adapting to evolving publishing technologies and workflows
* Can coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders simultaneously

title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Nagpur
description:
**Your role**
=============


Talent Acquisition Partner \- Nagpur**What you'll be doing**
========================

**What We Need**


Corpay is currently looking to hire a Talent Acquisition Partner within our Human Resources division. This position falls under our corporate business and is located in the Nagpur office. In this role, the Talent Acquisition Partner (TAP) works closely with our India\-based teams to develop and execute methods of attracting, sourcing, assessing, and hiring top professional talent for the organization. The TAP manages the full\-cycle recruitment process, including preparing and posting job descriptions, sourcing candidates, coordinating the interview process, and presenting offers. The TAP is expected to meet hiring goals, maintain a robust pipeline of interested and qualified applicants, and contribute to various talent acquisition projects as assigned.

**How We Work**


As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will be expected to work in an onsite environment \- 5 days per week in the office. Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

* Company\-issued equipment
* Assigned Workspace in the office
* Formal, hands\-on training
 **Role Responsibilities**  

The responsibilities of the role will include:

* Sourcing passive and active candidates to build and maintain a quality talent pipeline for current and future workforce needs.
* Effectively communicating the company culture and roadmap to a broad range of candidates, prospects, and industry professionals.
* Working closely with management on all initiatives involving recruitment to ensure fairness in hiring practices.
* Working as a strategic partner to the business and building trust with hiring teams.
* Working closely with hiring managers to determine recruitment needs and develop a hiring strategy for each role.
* Preparing job descriptions and managing postings on CCS’s career website as well as other relevant posting websites.
* Managing all aspects of the full\-cycle recruitment process, including pre\-screening, interviews, reference checks, and offers.
* Updating the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).established recruitment process.
* Maintaining and promoting company policies and procedures of the recruitment process established.
* Strategizing and facilitating multiple methods of building talent pipelines and executing tactical research, referral generation, professional events, sourcing campaigns, and special projects full\-life\-cycle.
* Ensuring proper onboarding for new hires and the necessary paperwork is completed promptly and accurately.
* Acting as the subject matter expert to both the talent acquisition team and business, by guiding processes and leading recruiting calls.
* Creating and implementing strategies across multiple specialties within the individual recruiting team.
* Recruiting on international\-based requisitions as needed.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* 1 \- 3 years of recruiting experience managing full life cycle requisitions.
* Manage basic full\-cycle recruiting tasks for entry\-level and junior roles.
* Conduct initial screening, coordinate interviews, and support hiring decisions with documented insights.
* Build candidate pipelines through sourcing tools and proactive outreach.
* Maintain ATS data accuracy and ensure process compliance.
* Strong consulting, negotiation, and organizational skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient in working with PC applications, online recruitment, and applicant tracking systems.
* Detail\-oriented and self\-sufficient.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and accommodate multiple internal clients.
* Goal\-oriented with a successful track record of closing candidates from mid\-level up to leadership roles.
* Ability to provide accurate recruiting data such as TTF, Offer\-to\-Start ratio, and other key recruiting data and/or previously held to measurable metrics.
* Support TA projects including events, branding, and process enhancements.

**About Corpay**
================

**About Corpay**

  

Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.


At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.


As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre\-employment screening conducted by an authorized third\-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.

**Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:** Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.


Learn more about Corpay: https://www.corpay.com

 **Transparency \& Compliance**

 **Equal Opportunity Employer**


Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.

 **Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring**


Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology\-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes.

 **Candidate Privacy Notice**


For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https://www.corpay.com/privacy\-policy.

 **Pay Philosophy**


Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job\-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.

title: Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) Engineer
description:
**Company Description:** Finova Motors is dedicated to advancing electric motor technology for high performance, delivering specialized solutions for Satellite and Electic Vehicle applications. Finova Motors emphasizes innovation, quality, and efficiency in all its products and development efforts. Team members join a mission\-driven environment that is committed to cleaner, more efficient motors. The organization offers opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge projects that shape next\-generation motor technology.

**Role Description:** We are looking for an AIT Engineer who owns the complete physical lifecycle of our space products, from pre\-build structural and thermal analysis through precision manufacturing, assembly, integration, environmental test campaigns, validation, and handoff to launch service providers. This is not a support role. You will have full ownership of hardware readiness from TRL\-3 through TRL\-9, with direct responsibility for ensuring every unit that leaves our facility is test\-proven and fully documented.

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana, India (on\-site)

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**No of Positions:** 1 to 2

**Starting Date:** Sept 1st or earliest Possible.

**Starting Salary:** 12 CTC for hands\-on experienced candidate \+ ESOP

**What You Will Do**

**Design Analysis \- Pre\-Build**

* Perform structural FEA analysis on assembled motor and reaction wheel units \- rotor containment at high RPM, bearing seat integrity, launch load survival, and vibration mode prediction across the frequency range of the launch spectrum
* Conduct thermal modeling \- identify heat dissipation pathways, predict thermal equilibrium under continuous motor operation, and evaluate worst\-case hot spots at the winding, bearing, and housing interfaces
* Validate design intent against analysis results before committing to physical build \- flag structural, thermal, or integration failure risks early and work with the motor design engineer to resolve them
* Manufacturing drawings for assembly feasibility and tolerance stack\-up before release for machining

**Assembly \& Integration**

* Design, develop, and fabricate mechanical sub\-components \- housing structures, mounting brackets, bearing assemblies, test fixtures, and handling tooling \- required for prototype and qualification unit build
* Lead the full physical assembly and integration of all motor sub\-systems: spin motor, flywheel, bearing assembly, encoder, gimbal and nutation motor, launch lock mechanism, and structural enclosure
* Develop and maintain assembly procedures, work instructions, and inspection records for every build \- ensuring full traceability from component receipt to completed unit
* Coordinate hands\-on with electrical engineers during build phases to resolve integration issues as they arise \- connector routing, wire harness management, grounding, sensor alignment
* Maintain clean\-room discipline and ESD protocol during all assembly operations \- ISO Class 8 minimum

**Testing \& Validation**

* Design and execute test campaigns for assembled units \- functional bench testing, dynamometer characterization, thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, and EMI/EMC
* Own all test procedure documentation \- test plans, test setup descriptions, test reports, non\-conformance reports, calibration records, and corrective action logs
* Analyze test data and compare against pre\-build predictions \- identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and close the loop with design and analysis
* Support handoff of validated hardware to third\-party launch service providers and POEM integration teams \- ensuring all documentation meets external interface and acceptance requirements
* Track and report hardware readiness status across the TRL progression from engineering model (TRL\-3/4\) through qualification (TRL\-6/7\) to flight model (TRL\-8/9\)

**What We Are Looking For**

**Education**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Manufacturing Engineering \- essential
* M.Tech / M.Sc in Structural Analysis, Aerospace Structures, or Manufacturing \- preferred
* PhD candidates with relevant research in space hardware, precision mechanisms, or structural dynamics \- welcome
* Freshers with strong internship or project experience in hardware assembly, FEA analysis, or aerospace testing are encouraged to apply

**Experience**

* Hands\-on experience in precision mechanical assembly \- ideally in space, aerospace, or high\-precision manufacturing environments
* Practical experience running structural or thermal FEA analysis and using the results to make design decisions \- not just generating outputs
* Exposure to environmental test campaigns \- vibration, thermal vacuum, shock \- in any industry
* For freshers and postgraduate students: demonstrated project or thesis work in structural analysis, mechanism design, thermal management, or precision assembly is accepted in lieu of industry experience

**Software Skills \- Essential**

* Structural FEA: ANSYS Mechanical, SolidWorks Simulation, ABAQUS, or equivalent
* Thermal modeling: ANSYS Thermal, SolidWorks Flow Simulation, or equivalent thermal analysis tool
* CAD: SolidWorks, CATIA, or equivalent \- for fixture design and drawing review
* GD\&T and tolerance stack\-up analysis tools

**Technical Knowledge**

* Understanding of launch environment specifications \- random vibration, shock, sinusoidal sweep, acoustic \- and how they drive structural design decisions
* Thermal management principles for space hardware \- conduction\-dominant heat transfer, radiation in vacuum, outgassing\-safe materials
* Bearing assembly and preload principles for high\-RPM precision rotating machinery
* Familiarity with space hardware standards \- ECSS\-E\-ST\-10, ECSS\-Q\-ST\-70, or equivalent \- a strong advantage
* Knowledge of balancing procedures for rotating assemblies \- G1\.0 target for reaction wheel applications
* Understanding of clean\-room protocols, ESD protection, and contamination control
